title.zh: 卷325 列傳一百十二 李清时 姚立德 李宏 李奉翰 李亨特 何煟 何裕城 吴嗣爵 萨载 兰第锡 韩鑅
title.en: Volume 325 Biographies 112: Li Qingshi, Yao Lide, Li Hong, Li Fenghan, Li Hengte, He Wei, He Yucheng, Wu Sijue, Sa Zai, Lan Di Xi, Han Heng
title.raw: 卷325 列傳一百十二 李清时 姚立德 李宏 李奉翰 李亨特 何煟 何裕城 吴嗣爵 萨载 兰第锡 韩鑅

sentences.zh: 列傳一百十二

translations.literal: Biographies 112
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 112

sentences.zh: =李清時=李清時，字授侯，福建安溪人，大學士光地從孫。

translations.literal: Li Qingshi, styled Shouhou, a native of Anxi in Fujian, a collateral descendant of Grand Secretary Guangdi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qingshi, whose courtesy name was Shouhou, came from Anxi in Fujian and was a collateral descendant of the Grand Secretary Li Guangdi.

sentences.zh: 乾隆七年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Qianlong he became a jinshi, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the seventh year of the Qianlong reign, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed a compiler.

sentences.zh: 十四年，授浙江嘉興知府。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was appointed prefect of Jiaxing in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong he was made prefect of Jiaxing in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 上南巡，或議自嘉興至杭州別闢道行民舟，清時於官塘外求得水道相屬，上通吳江平望，下達杭州壩子門，號為副河。

translations.literal: When the emperor made a southern tour, some proposed opening a separate channel from Jiaxing to Hangzhou for civilian boats; Qingshi found a connected waterway outside the official embankment, reaching Pingwang in Wujiang above and Bazimen in Hangzhou below, called the auxiliary canal.
translations.idiomatic: During an imperial southern tour, some officials proposed cutting a separate route from Jiaxing to Hangzhou for civilian vessels. Qingshi located a continuous waterway beyond the official embankment that ran up to Pingwang in Wujiang and down to Bazimen in Hangzhou, which was named the auxiliary canal.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂，去官。

translations.literal: Upon his father's death he left office.
translations.idiomatic: When his father died he resigned his post to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 服除，授山東兗州知府。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was appointed prefect of Yanzhou in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: After the mourning period he was appointed prefect of Yanzhou in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，擢運河道。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was promoted to intendant of the Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year of Qianlong he was promoted to intendant of the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，河決孫家集，運河由夏鎮至南陽兩堤俱潰，清時督修築。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the river broke at Sunjiaji; from Xiazhen to Nanyang both banks of the canal collapsed, and Qingshi supervised repairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year the Yellow River burst at Sunjiaji, and both dikes of the canal from Xiazhen to Nanyang gave way; Qingshi supervised the reconstruction.

sentences.zh: 議者或擬用椿埽，費以六十萬計；

translations.literal: Some advisers proposed using pile-and-mat works, costing about six hundred thousand taels;
translations.idiomatic: Some planners proposed pile-and-mat revetments at a cost of about six hundred thousand taels;

sentences.zh: 或擬建石堤，費以三百萬計。

translations.literal: others proposed stone dikes at a cost of about three million.
translations.idiomatic: others proposed stone dikes at a cost of about three million taels.

sentences.zh: 清時少時行瀕海間，見築堤捍海為田者，擲碎石積水中，潮退則以木攔之，填土其上，堅築成堤；

translations.literal: In youth Qingshi had traveled along the coast and seen those who built dikes against the sea to reclaim fields: they cast broken stone into the water, and when the tide receded they barred it with timber, heaped earth on top, and built a solid dike;
translations.idiomatic: As a young man Qingshi had traveled the coast and seen how people built sea dikes to reclaim farmland: they threw rubble into the water, and when the tide fell they set timbers to hold it in place, piled earth on top, and compacted it into a solid embankment;

sentences.zh: 因參用其法，以河東、西兩岸皆水，得土難，令以石壘兩旁，積葑其中，水涸，募夫起土置積葑上，費帑十四萬有奇，而兩堤成。

translations.literal: He therefore adapted the method: as both east and west banks were under water and earth was hard to obtain, he ordered stone piled on both sides with aquatic plants heaped within; when the water dried he hired laborers to raise earth onto the plants; the cost was a little over one hundred forty thousand taels, and both dikes were completed.
translations.idiomatic: He adapted this method: because both banks of the river were submerged and earth was hard to obtain, he had stone piled along both sides with aquatic plants heaped in the middle; when the water dropped he hired workers to raise earth onto the plant fill. The work cost a little over 140,000 taels, and both dikes were finished.

sentences.zh: 曹縣溢，水瀉入微山湖，出韓莊湖口，閘隘，水不得洩，令於閘北毀石堤，掘地深之以洩水。

translations.literal: When Caoxian overflowed, water poured into Weishan Lake and exited at Hanzhuang Lake mouth; the sluice was narrow and water could not drain, so he ordered the stone dike north of the sluice destroyed and the ground dug deep to release water.
translations.idiomatic: When Caoxian flooded, the water poured into Weishan Lake and exited at the Hanzhuang Lake mouth, but the sluice was too narrow to discharge it, so he ordered the stone dike north of the sluice torn down and the ground excavated deeply to let the water out.

sentences.zh: 事上聞，上命於其地建滾水壩，高一丈二尺餘。

translations.literal: The matter was reported to the throne; the emperor ordered a spillway dam built there, a little over twelve feet high.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor learned of this, he ordered a spillway dam built on the site, a little over twelve feet high.

sentences.zh: 清時請減低為一丈，令湖水落至丈，乃閉閘蓄水。

translations.literal: Qingshi asked that it be lowered to ten feet and that the sluice be closed to store water only when the lake fell to that level.
translations.idiomatic: Qingshi requested that it be lowered to ten feet and that the sluice be closed to store water only after the lake level had fallen to that height.

sentences.zh: 泗水經兗州西流入府河，濟寧城東舊有楊家壩，遏水使入馬場湖，蓄以濟運，遇伏秋水漲不能洩，淹民田，令改壩為閘，視水盛衰為啟閉。

translations.literal: The Si River passed west of Yanzhou into the prefectural canal; east of Jining city there was formerly the Yang family dam, holding water into Machang Lake to supply transport; in the dog days and autumn floods it could not drain and drowned fields, so he ordered the dam changed to a sluice, opened and closed according to the rise and fall of water.
translations.idiomatic: The Si River flowed west of Yanzhou into the prefectural canal. East of Jining there had long been the Yang family dam, which held water into Machang Lake to supply the transport system; during the midsummer and autumn floods it could not drain and inundated farmland, so he ordered the dam converted to a sluice that would be opened or closed according to the water level.

sentences.zh: 汶水分流入蜀山、馬踏兩湖，舊制引水使南行少北行多，後乃反之，漕船經袁口、靳口，淺澀不能進。

translations.literal: The Wen River divided into Shushan and Mata lakes; under the old system less water went south and more north, but later this was reversed, and grain boats passing Yuan and Jin mouths could not advance because of shallows.
translations.idiomatic: The Wen River divided into the Shushan and Mata lakes. Under the old system less water was sent south and more north, but later this was reversed, and grain transports passing Yuan and Jin mouths ran aground in the shallows.

sentences.zh: 清時規分水口，令南壩加長，北壩收短，以為節宣，並減低何家壩，使汶水南弱而北增。

translations.literal: Qingshi regulated the division point, lengthening the southern dam and shortening the northern for moderation, and also lowered the He family dam so that Wen water was weaker in the south and stronger in the north.
translations.idiomatic: Qingshi regulated the division point by lengthening the southern dam and shortening the northern one to balance the flow, and also lowered the He family dam so that the Wen River sent less water south and more north.

sentences.zh: 蜀山湖出口為利運、金線二閘，舊制開金線資南運。

translations.literal: The outlet of Shushan Lake had the Liyun and Jinxian sluices; under the old system Jinxian was opened to aid southern transport.
translations.idiomatic: The outlet of Shushan Lake had the Liyun and Jinxian sluices; under the old system the Jinxian sluice was opened to supply the southern transport route.

sentences.zh: 清時令移金線在利運北，使蜀山湖水先濟北運。

translations.literal: Qingshi ordered Jinxian moved north of Liyun so that Shushan Lake water would first supply northern transport.
translations.idiomatic: Qingshi ordered the Jinxian sluice moved north of Liyun so that water from Shushan Lake would first supply the northern transport route.

sentences.zh: 壽張境有沙、趙二水，阻運河不得入海。

translations.literal: In Shouzhang territory were the Sha and Zhao rivers, blocking the canal from reaching the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Within Shouzhang lay the Sha and Zhao rivers, which blocked the canal from reaching the sea.

sentences.zh: 舊於運河東岸建三空五孔橋，又於八里廟建平水三徬，使二水盛漲有所洩。

translations.literal: Formerly a three-span five-opening bridge was built on the canal's east bank, and at Balimiao three level spillways, so that when the two rivers swelled there was an outlet.
translations.idiomatic: Previously a three-span, five-opening bridge had been built on the east bank of the canal, and three level spillways at Balimiao, so that when the two rivers rose there was somewhere for the water to go.

sentences.zh: 清時議減低三空五孔橋，又於八里廟增​​建滾水壩，使漲未盛即洩，不為範、濮、壽張、東阿諸縣民田害。

translations.literal: Qingshi proposed lowering the three-span five-opening bridge and adding spillway dams at Balimiao so that floods would drain before peaking and not harm fields in Fan, Pu, Shouzhang, Dong'e, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: Qingshi proposed lowering the three-span, five-opening bridge and adding spillway dams at Balimiao so that floods could be discharged before they peaked and would not damage farmland in Fan, Pu, Shouzhang, Dong'e, and neighboring counties.

sentences.zh: 總督方觀承行河，用其議，二水始宣暢。

translations.literal: Governor-General Fang Guancheng managed the river works and adopted his plan; the two rivers then flowed freely.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Fang Guancheng, who was in charge of the river works, adopted his plan, and the two rivers at last ran freely.

sentences.zh: 衛水自館陶至臨清與汶會，舊有閘，盛漲不能禦。

translations.literal: The Wei River from Guantao to Linqing joined the Wen; there was formerly a sluice that could not hold back great floods.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei River ran from Guantao to Linqing, where it joined the Wen. The old sluice there could not withstand major floods.

sentences.zh: 清時令於閘南當汶、衛交流處築壩，仍歲加高厚；

translations.literal: Qingshi ordered a dam built south of the sluice where the Wen and Wei met, and each year it was raised and thickened;
translations.idiomatic: Qingshi ordered a dam built south of the sluice at the confluence of the Wen and Wei, and each year it was raised and thickened further;

sentences.zh: 又議拓四女寺滾水壩。

translations.literal: he also proposed widening the spillway dam at Sinü Temple.
translations.idiomatic: he also proposed widening the spillway dam at Sinü Temple.

sentences.zh: 尚書裘曰修行河，用其議，衛河得安流。

translations.literal: Minister Qiu Yixiu managed the river works and adopted his plan; the Wei River then flowed peacefully.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Qiu Yixiu, who was managing the river works, adopted his proposals, and the Wei River flowed peacefully thereafter.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，調江南淮徐道。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was transferred to the Huai-Xu circuit in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he was transferred to the Huai-Xu circuit in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 三十年，擢河東河道總督，賜其母大緞、貂皮。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was promoted to Governor-General of the Eastern River Works and his mother was given large satin and sable fur.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he was promoted to Governor-General of the Eastern River Works, and his mother was granted large bolts of satin and sable fur.

sentences.zh: 清時以河堤歲修，司其事者每不度形勢，過高糜帑，而卑薄者不能大有增益，乃飭所司當水漲各具堤高水面尺寸呈報，擇堤最薄者培之。

translations.literal: Qingshi observed that in annual dike repairs those in charge often did not gauge conditions, built too high and wasted funds, while low thin sections gained little; he ordered that at high water each office report dike height and water level, and the thinnest sections be strengthened.
translations.idiomatic: Qingshi found that in the annual dike repairs those in charge often failed to read the terrain, building sections too high and wasting funds while leaving low, thin stretches barely improved. He ordered that during high water each office report the height of the dikes and the water surface, and that the thinnest sections be reinforced.

sentences.zh: 迨伏秋水發，耿家寨稱十四堡，水及舊堤上，賴豫增新築以免。

translations.literal: When the dog-day and autumn floods came, at Gengjiazhai, called the Fourteen Forts, water reached the old dike top, but thanks to the newly built reinforcement they were spared.
translations.idiomatic: When the midsummer and autumn floods came, at Gengjiazhai—known as the Fourteen Forts—the water rose to the top of the old dikes, but the newly reinforced sections held and disaster was averted.

sentences.zh: 清釐河工徵料諸弊，歲減派料至千餘萬斤。

translations.literal: He cleared abuses in river-work material levies, reducing annual requisitions by more than ten million jin.
translations.idiomatic: He rooted out abuses in the levying of river-work materials, cutting annual requisitions by more than ten million jin.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，運河東岸漫口，自請議處，原之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year the east bank of the canal breached; he asked to be punished and was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year the east bank of the canal breached. He asked to be held accountable and was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 三十二年七月，授山東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the thirty-second year he was appointed Governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the thirty-second year he was appointed governor of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 高苑、博興、樂安​​三縣被水，清時謂小清河下流隘，故上游溢，檄所司勘驗。

translations.literal: Gaoyuan, Boxing, and Le'an were flooded; Qingshi said the lower Xiaoqing River was narrow and the upper course overflowed, and ordered investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Gaoyuan, Boxing, and Le'an were inundated. Qingshi held that the lower Xiaoqing River was too narrow, causing the upper course to overflow, and ordered an on-site survey.

sentences.zh: 遽疾作，乞解任，不許。

translations.literal: Suddenly illness struck; he begged to resign and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He was suddenly stricken with illness and asked to resign, but the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，卒。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year he died.

sentences.zh: 清時治水善相度情形，窮源竟委。

translations.literal: Qingshi was skilled at water control in surveying conditions and tracing sources to their ends.
translations.idiomatic: In managing water, Qingshi excelled at reading the terrain and tracing each river to its source and outlet.

sentences.zh: 每乘小舟出入荒陂叢澤、支流斷港中，或徒步按行諮訪，必得要領，乃見諸建置。

translations.literal: He often took a small boat through wild marshes and cut-off channels, or walked to inspect and inquire, and only when he had the essentials did he put plans into practice.
translations.idiomatic: He often went by small boat through wild marshes and cut-off channels, or walked the ground to inspect and inquire in person, and only after he had grasped the essentials did he put his plans into effect.

sentences.zh: =姚立德=姚立德，字次功，浙江仁和人。

translations.literal: Yao Lide, styled Cigong, a native of Renhe in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Lide, whose courtesy name was Cigong, came from Renhe in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 祖三辰，官吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: His grandfather Sanchen served as Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yao Sanchen had served as vice minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 立德以廕生授主事。

translations.literal: Lide entered office by yin privilege as a secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Lide entered office through the yin privilege as a secretary.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十二年，外授江寧通判，遷知直隸景州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Qianlong he was sent out as vice-prefect of Jiangning and promoted to magistrate of Jingzhou in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Qianlong he was posted outside the capital as vice-prefect of Jiangning and later promoted to magistrate of Jingzhou in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 州俗，有人市鬻奴婢，牽就牙儈估其值，如牲畜然；

translations.literal: Local custom was for people to sell male and female slaves in the market, leading them to brokers to appraise their value like livestock;
translations.idiomatic: Local custom allowed people to sell male and female slaves in the market, leading them to brokers to have their price set as if they were livestock;

sentences.zh: 親死三日，祭城隍廟獄曰「哭廟」：立德諭禁之，陋俗以革。

translations.literal: three days after a parent's death they sacrificed at the city-god temple prison, called "weeping at the temple": Lide forbade it by edict and the vulgar custom was reformed.
translations.idiomatic: three days after a parent's death families would perform a rite called "weeping at the temple" at the city-god temple prison: Lide forbade it by proclamation, and the vulgar custom was abolished.

sentences.zh: 累遷山東按察使，署河東河道總督。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Shandong judicial commissioner and acted as Governor-General of the Eastern River Works.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to judicial commissioner of Shandong and served concurrently as acting governor-general of the Eastern River Works.

sentences.zh: 按行工次，見陽武汛十七堡諸地土松浮，疏請築半戧，培堤使堅。

translations.literal: On inspection of works he saw that at Yangwu flood section the Seventeen Forts and other places had loose floating soil; he memorialized to build half-slope revetments and strengthen the dikes.
translations.idiomatic: While inspecting the works he found that at the Yangwu flood section the Seventeen Forts and neighboring stretches had loose, unstable soil. He memorialized to build half-slope revetments and consolidate the dikes.

sentences.zh: 山東運河兩岸蜀山、南旺、馬場、昭陽、微山諸湖，每伏秋盛漲，水不能容，為豫籌蓄洩，壩開塞、閘啟閉惟其時。

translations.literal: On both banks of the Shandong canal, Shushan, Nanwang, Machang, Zhaoyang, Weishan, and other lakes each dog-day and autumn rose high and could not hold all the water; he prepared storage and release in advance, opening and closing dams and sluices at the right time.
translations.idiomatic: Along both banks of the Shandong canal, the lakes at Shushan, Nanwang, Machang, Zhaoyang, Weishan, and elsewhere swelled each midsummer and autumn beyond their capacity. He planned storage and discharge in advance, opening and closing dams and sluices only at the proper moment.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，實授，加兵部尚書銜。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year he received substantive appointment and was given the rank of Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year he received a substantive appointment and was given the rank of minister of war.

sentences.zh: 高雲龍者，內監高雲從弟也，立德入雲從言，薦之臨清州為傔從，坐逮，依結交近侍律論斬，命奪官，仍留任。

translations.literal: Gao Yunlong was the younger cousin of eunuch Gao Yun; Lide spoke to Yun on his behalf and recommended him as a retainer at Linqing; he was arrested and, under the statute on associating with palace attendants, sentenced to decapitation; the emperor ordered his office stripped but he remained at his post.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yunlong was the younger cousin of the eunuch Gao Yun. Lide spoke to Gao Yun on his behalf and recommended Yunlong as a retainer at Linqing. When this came to light he was arrested and, under the statute on associating with palace attendants, sentenced to decapitation; the emperor stripped him of his rank but allowed him to remain at his post.

sentences.zh: 陽穀民王倫為亂，立德分守東昌，城圮難守，引運河水繞城壕，恃以為固；

translations.literal: Wang Lun of Yanggu raised a rebellion; Lide was assigned to defend Dongchang; the walls were ruined and hard to hold, so he led canal water around the moat and relied on it for defense;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lun of Yanggu raised a rebellion. Lide was assigned to defend Dongchang. The walls were in ruins and hard to hold, so he diverted canal water around the moat and relied on it for defense;

sentences.zh: 檄發倫先墓，磔其屍。

translations.literal: he ordered Lun's ancestral tomb opened and his corpse dismembered.
translations.idiomatic: he ordered Lun's ancestral tomb opened and his corpse dismembered.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，儀封河決，屢築屢衝，命奪官，仍留工效力自贖。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year the river broke at Yifeng; dikes were built and repeatedly washed away; he was stripped of office but kept at the works to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year the river broke at Yifeng; dikes were built and repeatedly washed away. He was stripped of his rank but kept at the works to redeem himself through service.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，責令回籍。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year he was ordered to return to his native place.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year he was ordered to return to his native place.

sentences.zh: 旋發往南河，補淮安里河同知。

translations.literal: Soon he was sent to the Southern River Works and appointed vice-prefect of the inner canal at Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was sent to the Southern River Works and appointed vice-prefect of the inner canal at Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，卒。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year he died.

sentences.zh: =李宏=李宏，字濟夫，漢軍正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Li Hong, styled Jifu, a Bannerman of the Plain Blue Hanjun.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hong, whose courtesy name was Jifu, was a Hanjun bannerman of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 監生，入貲授州同。

translations.literal: A student of the Imperial Academy, he purchased office as assistant prefect.
translations.idiomatic: A student of the Imperial Academy, he purchased office as an assistant prefect.

sentences.zh: 效力河工，授山陽縣外河縣丞。

translations.literal: He served in river works and was appointed outer-canal assistant magistrate of Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: He served in river works and was appointed assistant magistrate of the outer canal at Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 累遷宿虹同知。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice-prefect of Suqian and Hongze.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to vice-prefect of Suqian and Hongze.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十六年，授河庫道。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Qianlong he was appointed intendant of the river treasury.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Qianlong he was appointed intendant of the river treasury.

sentences.zh: 尚書劉統勳劾河員虧帑，事連宏，解職。

translations.literal: Minister Liu Tongxun impeached river officials for treasury deficits; Hong was implicated and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Liu Tongxun impeached river officials for treasury deficits; Hong was implicated and dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 事白，留工。

translations.literal: When the matter was cleared he remained at the works.
translations.idiomatic: When he was cleared of wrongdoing he remained at the river works.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，發直隸以河務同知用，總督尹繼善疏請留南河。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was sent to Zhili for use as river-works vice-prefect; Governor-General Yin Jishan memorialized to keep him on the Southern River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was posted to Zhili as a river-works vice-prefect; Governor-General Yin Jishan memorialized to keep him on the Southern River Works.

sentences.zh: 侍郎夢麟勘治六塘河以下，以​​宏從。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Menglin surveyed and managed the Liutang River and below, with Hong accompanying.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Meng Lin surveyed and managed the Liutang River and below, with Hong accompanying him.

sentences.zh: 尋复補河庫道，丁父憂，命在任守制。

translations.literal: Soon he was reappointed intendant of the river treasury; upon his father's death he was ordered to observe mourning without leaving his post.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was reappointed intendant of the river treasury. When his father died he was ordered to observe mourning without leaving his post.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，調淮徐道。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was transferred to the Huai-Xu circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year he was transferred to the Huai-Xu circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，擢河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was promoted to Governor-General of the Eastern River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he was promoted to governor-general of the Eastern River Works.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「山東運河資湖水接濟。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The Shandong canal relies on lake water for supply.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The Shandong canal relies on lake water for supply.

sentences.zh: 今秋雨少，飭早閉臨運各閘。」

translations.literal: This autumn rain has been scant; order the early closing of all sluices along the transport route."
translations.idiomatic: This autumn the rains have been scant; order the sluices along the transport route closed early."

sentences.zh: 又言：「微山湖蓄水濟運。

translations.literal: He also said: "Weishan Lake stores water to supply transport.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Weishan Lake stores water to supply the transport system.

sentences.zh: 韓莊湖口閘水深，與滾水壩脊相平，空船足敷浮送，即應堵閉。

translations.literal: At Hanzhuang Lake mouth the sluice water is deep, level with the spillway crest; empty boats can float through, so it should be closed at once.
translations.idiomatic: At the Hanzhuang Lake mouth the sluice water is deep and level with the spillway crest; empty boats can pass through, so it should be closed at once.

sentences.zh: 泗河會合諸泉，收入獨山湖，僅濟南運。

translations.literal: The Si River gathers various springs and enters Dushan Lake, supplying only the southern transport route.
translations.idiomatic: The Si River gathers various springs and flows into Dushan Lake, supplying only the southern transport route.

sentences.zh: 應請於兗州府金口壩截築土偃，俾達馬場湖，俾濟寧上、下河道並資其益。

translations.literal: It should be requested that at Jinkou Dam in Yanzhou Prefecture an earthen barrier be built to divert water to Machang Lake so that the upper and lower canal sections at Jining may both benefit.
translations.idiomatic: It should be requested that an earthen barrier be built at Jinkou Dam in Yanzhou Prefecture to divert water to Machang Lake so that the upper and lower canal sections at Jining may both benefit.

sentences.zh: 蜀山、馬踏二湖專濟北運，亦須築壩收蓄。」

translations.literal: Shushan and Mata lakes supply only northern transport and also need dams to store water."
translations.idiomatic: Shushan and Mata lakes supply only the northern transport route and also need dams to store water."

sentences.zh: 又請增募夫役挑濬沙、趙、漳、衛、汶、泗、韓、馬諸水，均報聞。

translations.literal: He also asked to increase hired labor to dredge the Sha, Zhao, Zhang, Wei, Wen, Si, Han, and Ma waterways; all were reported and approved.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to increase hired labor to dredge the Sha, Zhao, Zhang, Wei, Wen, Si, Han, and Ma waterways; all were reported and approved.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「黃河北岸耿家寨埽工為豫東第一險要，自乾隆九年下埽修防，歲費帑料。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "On the north bank of the Yellow River the revetment works at Gengjiazhai are the foremost danger in eastern Henan; since the ninth year of Qianlong mat works have been laid for repair, costing treasury funds each year.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "On the north bank of the Yellow River the revetment works at Gengjiazhai are the foremost danger point in eastern Henan. Since the ninth year of Qianlong mat revetments have been laid for repair at annual cost to the treasury.

sentences.zh: 去冬於對岸引渠，冀分溜勢。

translations.literal: Last winter a channel was cut on the opposite bank, hoping to divide the current.
translations.idiomatic: Last winter a channel was cut on the opposite bank in the hope of dividing the current.

sentences.zh: 今秋全河暢分入渠，險工淤閉。」

translations.literal: This autumn the whole river flowed freely into the channel and the dangerous works silted shut."
translations.idiomatic: This autumn the whole river flowed freely into the channel and the dangerous works silted shut."

sentences.zh: 得旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: He received an edict of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: He received an edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 三十年，調江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was transferred to Governor-General of the Jiangnan River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he was transferred to governor-general of the Jiangnan River Works.

sentences.zh: 上以宏初自監司擢用，道廳以下多同官，慮有瞻徇，命高晉統理南河，留宏協理河東總河。

translations.literal: Because Hong had been promoted from circuit and prefect ranks and many subordinates were former colleagues, the emperor feared favoritism and ordered Gao Jin to oversee the Southern River Works overall while Hong remained to assist the Eastern River governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Because Hong had been promoted from the circuit and prefect ranks and many subordinates were former colleagues, the emperor feared favoritism and ordered Gao Jin to oversee the Southern River Works while Hong remained to assist the Eastern River governor-general.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「黃河至河南武陟、滎澤始有堤防，丹、沁二水自武陟木欒店匯入，伊、洛、瀍、澗四水自鞏縣洛口匯入，設諸水並漲，兩岸節節均須防守。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "From Wuzhi and Xingze in Henan the Yellow River first has dikes; the Dan and Qin rivers join at Muluan shop in Wuzhi, and the Yi, Luo, Chan, and Jian rivers join at Luokou in Gongxian; if all rise together, every section on both banks must be defended.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "From Wuzhi and Xingze in Henan the Yellow River first has dikes. The Dan and Qin rivers join at Muluan shop in Wuzhi, and the Yi, Luo, Chan, and Jian rivers join at Luokou in Gongxian. If all rise together, every section on both banks must be defended.

sentences.zh: 臣諮飭陝州於黃河出口處，鞏縣於伊、洛、瀍、澗入河處，黃沁同知於沁水入河處，各立水志​​，自桃汛迄霜降，長落尺寸，逐日登記具報；

translations.literal: Your servant has ordered Shanzhou to set water marks at the Yellow River outlet, Gongxian at the entry of the Yi, Luo, Chan, and Jian, and the Huang-Qin vice-prefect at the Qin River entry; from peach flood to frost descent, daily rise and fall in feet and inches are to be recorded and reported;
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has ordered Shanzhou to set water marks at the Yellow River outlet, Gongxian at the entry of the Yi, Luo, Chan, and Jian, and the Huang-Qin vice-prefect at the Qin River entry. From the peach flood season through frost descent, the daily rise and fall in feet and inches are to be recorded and reported;

sentences.zh: 如遇陡漲，飛報江南總河，嚴督修防。

translations.literal: if there is a sudden rise, urgent report to the Jiangnan governor-general for strict repair and defense.
translations.idiomatic: if there is a sudden rise, an urgent report is to be sent to the Jiangnan governor-general for strict repair and defense.

sentences.zh: 大丹河至河內縣丹谷口，舊築攔河石壩，令由小丹河歸衛濟運，請不時察驗疏令暢達衛河。

translations.literal: The Great Dan River reaches Dangu Valley in Henei; an old stone dam barred the river so water went by the Small Dan to the Wei to supply transport; request periodic inspection and dredging so the Wei flows freely.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Dan River reaches Dangu Valley in Henei, where an old stone dam barred the river so water would go by the Small Dan to the Wei to supply transport. He requested periodic inspection and dredging so the Wei would flow freely.

sentences.zh: 輝縣百泉為衛河之源，蘇門山下彙為巨浸。

translations.literal: The Hundred Springs of Huixian are the source of the Wei; below Sumen Mountain they gather into a great lake.
translations.idiomatic: The Hundred Springs of Huixian are the source of the Wei River; below Sumen Mountain they gather into a great lake.

sentences.zh: 南建三斗門，中為官渠濟運，東西為民渠灌田。

translations.literal: Southward three sluice gates were built: the center is the official canal for transport, east and west are civilian canals for irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: To the south three sluice gates were built: the center channel is the official canal for transport, and the east and west channels are civilian canals for irrigation.

sentences.zh: 向例重運抵臨清，閉民渠，使泉流盡入官渠。

translations.literal: Formerly when the heavy transport reached Linqing the civilian canals were closed so all spring flow entered the official canal.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly, when the heavy grain transport reached Linqing, the civilian canals were closed so that all spring flow entered the official canal.

sentences.zh: 五月後插秧，一日濟運，一日灌田。

translations.literal: After the fifth month, when rice is transplanted, one day supplies transport and one day irrigates fields.
translations.idiomatic: After the fifth month, when rice is transplanted, one day the water supplies transport and the next it irrigates the fields.

sentences.zh: 惟民渠石壩失修，泉水旁洩，應令修砌堅實。」

translations.literal: But the stone dams of the civilian canals are unrepaired and spring water leaks away; they should be rebuilt solidly."
translations.idiomatic: But the stone dams of the civilian canals are unrepaired and spring water leaks away; they should be rebuilt solidly."

sentences.zh: 均如議行。

translations.literal: All were approved as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved as proposed.

sentences.zh: 上以清口節宣未暢，下河田廬易湮，特定高堰五壩水志水高一尺，清口壩拆展十丈。

translations.literal: The emperor, finding regulation at Qingkou insufficient and lower-river fields and houses easily inundated, fixed the water mark at the five dams of Gaoyan one foot higher and ordered the Qingkou dam opened ten zhang wider.
translations.idiomatic: Finding that regulation at Qingkou was insufficient and that fields and houses on the lower river were easily inundated, the emperor fixed the water mark at the five dams of Gaoyan one foot higher and ordered the Qingkou dam opened ten zhang wider.

sentences.zh: 三十一年三月，宏奏言：「清口水門因上年霜降後湖水大消，祗留十四丈。

translations.literal: In the third month of the thirty-first year Hong memorialized: "At Qingkou the mouth, because lake water fell greatly after last year's frost descent, was left only fourteen zhang wide.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the thirty-first year Hong memorialized: "At Qingkou the mouth, because lake water fell greatly after last year's frost descent, was left only fourteen zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 桃汛將屆，應預將東壩拆展，使口門寬二十丈，俾洪湖及早騰空，預留容納之地。」

translations.literal: The peach flood is near; the east dam should be opened in advance to twenty zhang so Hongze Lake may empty early and room be reserved."
translations.idiomatic: The peach flood season is near; the east dam should be opened in advance to twenty zhang so that Hongze Lake may empty early and room be reserved."

sentences.zh: 上嘉之。

translations.literal: The emperor commended this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended this.

sentences.zh: 夏秋間湖水盛漲，續展至五十三丈。

translations.literal: In summer and autumn lake water rose greatly and the opening was extended to fifty-three zhang.
translations.idiomatic: In summer and autumn the lake water rose greatly and the opening was extended to fifty-three zhang.

sentences.zh: 八月，河溢徐州韓家塘。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the river overflowed at Hanjiatang in Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the river overflowed at Hanjiatang in Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 宏與高晉分駐兩壩堵築，踰月工竟。

translations.literal: Hong and Gao Jin stationed separately at the two dams to block and build; in over a month the work was finished.
translations.idiomatic: Hong and Gao Jin took separate posts at the two dams to block and repair them, and within a little over a month the work was finished.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「平時大展清口，騰空湖面，乃得蕆工迅速。」

translations.literal: He memorialized: "In normal times opening Qingkou widely to empty the lake surface allows work to be completed quickly."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "In normal times opening Qingkou widely to empty the lake surface allows the work to be completed quickly."

sentences.zh: 冬，以湖水漸落，請接築東、西壩，仍留口門二十丈，酌量收束，蓄清抵黃。

translations.literal: In winter, as lake water gradually fell, he asked to continue building the east and west dams, leaving the mouth twenty zhang wide, moderating the opening as needed to store clear water against the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, as the lake water gradually fell, he asked to continue building the east and west dams, leaving the mouth twenty zhang wide and moderating the opening as needed to store clear water against the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，河溢王家田頭，下吏議降調，寬之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year the river overflowed at Wangjiatiantou; subordinates proposed demotion, but he was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year the river overflowed at Wangjiatiantou. Subordinates proposed demotion, but he was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，奏言：「洪澤湖水大，將清口東、西壩遞展宣洩。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he memorialized: "Hongze Lake water is high; the east and west dams at Qingkou will be opened in succession to discharge.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year he memorialized: "Hongze Lake water is high; the east and west dams at Qingkou will be opened in succession to discharge it.

sentences.zh: 適黃水驟長，灌入清口。

translations.literal: Just then Yellow River water rose suddenly and poured into Qingkou.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Yellow River water rose suddenly and poured into Qingkou.

sentences.zh: 隨閉惠濟、通濟、福興三閘，俾並力敵黃，黃水消退。」

translations.literal: He then closed the Huiji, Tongji, and Fuxing sluices so all force could oppose the Yellow River, and the Yellow water receded."
translations.idiomatic: He then closed the Huiji, Tongji, and Fuxing sluices so that all force could be directed against the Yellow River, and the Yellow water receded."

sentences.zh: 報聞。

translations.literal: This was reported and noted.
translations.idiomatic: This was reported and noted.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，卒。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year he died.

sentences.zh: 宏嘗以明汶上老人白英立祠戴村，子孫向有廕襲，請旨仍給八品世職，上從之。

translations.literal: Hong had once had a shrine built at Daicun to Bai Ying, the old man of Wenshang in the Ming, whose descendants had enjoyed yin privilege; he asked that the eighth-rank hereditary office still be granted, and the emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Hong had once had a shrine built at Daicun to Bai Ying, the old man of Wenshang in the Ming, whose descendants had enjoyed yin privilege. He asked that the eighth-rank hereditary office still be granted, and the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 李奉翰，宏子。

translations.literal: Li Fenghan was Hong's son.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fenghan was Hong's son.

sentences.zh: 入貲授縣丞，補沂水。

translations.literal: He purchased office as assistant magistrate and was posted to Yishui.
translations.idiomatic: He purchased office as an assistant magistrate and was posted to Yishui.

sentences.zh: 累遷江蘇蘇松太道，坐事罷。

translations.literal: He was promoted to the Su-Song-Tai circuit in Jiangsu and dismissed for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to the Su-Song-Tai circuit in Jiangsu and was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 復入貲還原官，發江南河工效力，奏署河庫道。

translations.literal: He purchased office again to restore his rank, was sent to serve on the Jiangnan river works, and memorialized to act as intendant of the river treasury.
translations.idiomatic: He purchased office again to restore his rank, was sent to serve on the Jiangnan river works, and memorialized to act as intendant of the river treasury.

sentences.zh: 上以奉翰宏子，習河事，命真除。

translations.literal: Because Fenghan was Hong's son and versed in river affairs, the emperor ordered substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Because Fenghan was Hong's son and versed in river affairs, the emperor ordered a substantive appointment.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，署江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year he acted as Governor-General of the Jiangnan River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year he served as acting governor-general of the Jiangnan River Works.

sentences.zh: 四十五年二月，授河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the second month of the forty-fifth year he was appointed Governor-General of the Eastern River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the forty-fifth year he was appointed governor-general of the Eastern River Works.

sentences.zh: 河溢考城芝麻莊、張家油房，奉翰督吏塞芝麻莊，工竟。

translations.literal: The river overflowed at Zhimazhuang and Zhangjiayoufang in Kaocheng; Fenghan supervised officials in blocking Zhimazhuang, and the work was finished.
translations.idiomatic: The river overflowed at Zhimazhuang and Zhangjiayoufang in Kaocheng. Fenghan supervised officials in blocking Zhimazhuang, and the work was finished.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「勉為之，莫以水弱而弛其敬謹！」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Work hard at it; do not relax your diligence because the water is weak!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed him: "Work hard at it; do not relax your diligence because the water is weak!"

sentences.zh: 旋命仍署江南河道總督。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered again to act as Governor-General of the Jiangnan River Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered again to serve as acting governor-general of the Jiangnan River Works.

sentences.zh: 奉翰奏：「張家油房工未竟，較南河睢寧工為要。

translations.literal: Fenghan memorialized: "The work at Zhangjiayoufang is not finished and is more important than the Suining work on the Southern River.
translations.idiomatic: Fenghan memorialized: "The work at Zhangjiayoufang is not finished and is more important than the Suining work on the Southern River.

sentences.zh: 請留河東，俾蕆其役。」

translations.literal: I ask to remain on the Eastern River Works to complete this task."
translations.idiomatic: I ask to remain on the Eastern River Works to complete this task."

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 九月，張家油房工亦竟，上為欣慰。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Zhangjiayoufang work was also finished, and the emperor was pleased.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Zhangjiayoufang work was also finished, and the emperor was pleased.

sentences.zh: 四十六正月，調江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the first month of the forty-sixth year he was transferred to Governor-General of the Jiangnan River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the forty-sixth year he was transferred to governor-general of the Jiangnan River Works.

sentences.zh: 二月，奏請重定南河汛員額缺，酌增河兵；

translations.literal: In the second month he memorialized to redefine flood-section posts on the Southern River and increase river troops as appropriate;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he memorialized to redefine flood-section posts on the Southern River and increase river troops as appropriate;

sentences.zh: 移改運河閘官、運河汛員，視缺簡要，更定品秩，下大學士九卿議行。

translations.literal: to transfer canal sluice officials and flood-section officers according to the importance of each post and reset their ranks; this was referred to the Grand Secretaries and Nine Ministers for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: to transfer canal sluice officials and flood-section officers according to the importance of each post and reset their ranks. The proposal was referred to the Grand Secretaries and Nine Ministers for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 七月，河決青龍岡，命偕大學士阿桂馳赴河南會河東河道總督韓鑅督辦東、西兩壩下埽。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the river broke at Qinglonggang; he was ordered to hurry to Henan with Grand Secretary Agui to join Eastern River Governor-General Han Heng in supervising mat works below the east and west dams.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the river broke at Qinglonggang. He was ordered to hurry to Henan with Grand Secretary Agui to join Eastern River governor-general Han Heng in supervising mat works below the east and west dams.

sentences.zh: 甫合龍，壩蟄陷，乃與阿桂等議寬濬青龍岡迤下至孔家莊、榮華寺、楊家堂諸地引河，並於黃河下游北岸疏潘家屯、張家莊二引河、蘇家山水線河、宿遷十字河、桃源顧家莊引河，五道洩水。

translations.literal: Just as the closure was joined the dam sank; he then discussed with Agui and others widening and dredging diversion channels from Qinglonggang down to Kongjiazhuang, Ronghuasi, Yangjiatang, and other places, and on the north bank below opening five diversion channels at Panjiatun, Zhangjiazhuang, the Su Family Mountain waterline river, the Shizi River at Suqian, and the Gujiazhuang diversion at Taoyuan to release water.
translations.idiomatic: Just as the closure was joined the dam sank. He then discussed with Agui and others widening and dredging diversion channels from Qinglonggang down to Kongjiazhuang, Ronghuasi, Yangjiatang, and other places, and on the north bank below opening five diversion channels at Panjiatun, Zhangjiazhuang, the Su Family Mountain waterline river, the Shizi River at Suqian, and the Gujiazhuang diversion at Taoyuan to release water.

sentences.zh: 四十八年春，青龍岡工竟。

translations.literal: In the spring of the forty-eighth year the Qinglonggang work was finished.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the forty-eighth year the Qinglonggang work was finished.

sentences.zh: 方壩陷，奉翰督吏搶護，墮入金門，格於纜，傷焉，河工謂兩壩間為金門，纜所以引埽者，事聞上。

translations.literal: When the dam sank, Fenghan supervised officials in emergency repair, fell into the Golden Gate, was caught by the cable, and was injured; river workers call the space between the two dams the Golden Gate, and the cable is used to guide the mats; the matter was reported to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: When the dam sank, Fenghan supervised officials in emergency repair, fell into the Golden Gate, was caught by the cable, and was injured. River workers call the space between the two dams the Golden Gate, and the cable is used to guide the mats. The matter was reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，上南巡，奉翰覲行在，上獎其勤勞，賜騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year, during the emperor's southern tour, Fenghan presented himself at the traveling palace; the emperor praised his diligence and granted a hereditary office as Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year, during the emperor's southern tour, Fenghan presented himself at the traveling palace. The emperor praised his diligence and granted him a hereditary office as Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 五十年，坐清口東、西兩壩不早收束，致運道淺阻，降三品頂帶。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year, because the east and west dams at Qingkou were not closed early and the transport route became shallow and obstructed, he was demoted to third-rank insignia.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year, because the east and west dams at Qingkou were not closed early and the transport route became shallow and obstructed, he was demoted to third-rank insignia.

sentences.zh: 尋命復之。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered restored.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was ordered restored.

sentences.zh: 秋，河水大至，奉翰督吏晝夜填築，塞李家莊、煙墩頭、司家莊、湯家莊諸漫口。

translations.literal: In autumn great floods came; Fenghan supervised officials day and night in filling and building, closing breaches at Lijiazhuang, Yanduntou, Sijiazhuang, Tangjiazhuang, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn great floods came. Fenghan supervised officials day and night in filling and building, closing breaches at Lijiazhuang, Yanduntou, Sijiazhuang, Tangjiazhuang, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，調河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year he was transferred to Governor-General of the Eastern River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year he was transferred to governor-general of the Eastern River Works.

sentences.zh: 五十八年，命赴浙江會巡撫吉慶會勘海塘。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year he was ordered to Zhejiang to join Governor Ji Qing in surveying the sea dikes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-eighth year he was ordered to Zhejiang to join Governor Ji Qing in surveying the sea dikes.

sentences.zh: 奏請以范公塘及海寧石壩改築柴盤頭，並於石塘前修補坦水，三官塘柴工後加培土戧，從之。

translations.literal: He memorialized to rebuild Fan Gong embankment and the Haining stone dam as brush revetments, repair the slope protection before the stone dike, and add earthen half-slope reinforcement after the Sanguantang brush works; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to rebuild Fan Gong embankment and the Haining stone dam as brush revetments, repair the slope protection before the stone dike, and add earthen half-slope reinforcement after the Sanguantang brush works. This was approved.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，漳水溢，臨漳三台漲發，命馳往勘察。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year the Zhang River overflowed and the three platforms at Linzhang rose; he was ordered to hurry there to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year the Zhang River overflowed and the three platforms at Linzhang rose. He was ordered to hurry there to investigate.

sentences.zh: 奏：「漳河兩岸沙土浮松，水勢驟長驟落，向無堤堰。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "On both banks of the Zhang River the sandy soil is loose; water rises and falls abruptly, and there have been no dikes.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "On both banks of the Zhang River the sandy soil is loose; the water rises and falls abruptly, and there have been no dikes.

sentences.zh: 上年大雨漫溢，應將下游淤墊處疏濬深通，再將三台壩基填築，俾歸故道。」

translations.literal: Last year's heavy rain caused overflow; the silted lower course should be dredged deep and clear, and the three-platform dam base filled and built so the river returns to its old channel."
translations.idiomatic: Last year's heavy rain caused overflow. The silted lower course should be dredged deep and clear, and the three-platform dam base filled and built so that the river returns to its old channel."

sentences.zh: 上從其議。

translations.literal: The emperor adopted his proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor adopted his proposal.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年正月，加太子太保，授兩江總督，兼領南河事。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Jiaqing he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, appointed Governor-General of the Two Jiangs, and concurrently placed in charge of the Southern River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Jiaqing he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, appointed governor-general of the Two Jiangs, and concurrently placed in charge of the Southern River Works.

sentences.zh: 三年，河決睢寧。

translations.literal: In the third year the river broke at Suining.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the river broke at Suining.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，與河道總督康基田督塞睢州決口，工竟。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, with River Works Governor-General Kang Jitian he supervised closing the breach at Suizhou; the work was finished.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, with river works governor-general Kang Jitian he supervised closing the breach at Suizhou, and the work was finished.

sentences.zh: 二月，卒。

translations.literal: In the second month he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he died.

sentences.zh: 李亨特，奉翰次子。

translations.literal: Li Hengte was Fenghan's second son.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hengte was Fenghan's second son.

sentences.zh: 入貲授布政司理問，發河東委用，補兗州通判。

translations.literal: He purchased office as secretary in the provincial administration commission, was sent to the Eastern River Works for assignment, and appointed vice-prefect of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He purchased office as a secretary in the provincial administration commission, was sent to the Eastern River Works for assignment, and was appointed vice-prefect of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 累遷雲南迤西道。

translations.literal: He was promoted to the Yixi circuit in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to the Yixi circuit in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，佐平苗、倮，賜孔雀翎，加按察使銜。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiaqing he assisted in pacifying the Miao and Luo, was granted a peacock feather, and given the rank of surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jiaqing reign he assisted in pacifying the Miao and Luo, was granted a peacock feather, and given the rank of surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 累遷調授江蘇按察使。

translations.literal: He was promoted and transferred to judicial commissioner of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted and transferred to judicial commissioner of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 九年，擢河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was promoted to Governor-General of the Eastern River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was promoted to governor-general of the Eastern River Works.

sentences.zh: 十一年，河南巡撫馬慧裕劾亨特索屬吏賕不得，迫令告養諸狀，上命侍郎托津等往按，奪官，發伊犁。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Henan Governor Ma Huiyu impeached Hengte for demanding bribes from subordinates and, when refused, forcing them to request leave on grounds of illness; the emperor ordered Vice Minister Tuojin and others to investigate; his office was stripped and he was sent to Yili.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Henan governor Ma Huiyu impeached Hengte for demanding bribes from subordinates and, when refused, forcing them to request leave on grounds of illness. The emperor ordered Vice Minister Tuojin and others to investigate. Hengte was stripped of his office and sent to Yili.

sentences.zh: 十三年，釋還，令至南河候差委。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was released and ordered to the Southern River Works to await assignment.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was released and ordered to the Southern River Works to await assignment.

sentences.zh: 十四年，以河決荷花塘，追咎亨特不善料理，復發熱河效力。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, because the river broke at Hehuatang, Hengte was blamed for poor management and again sent to Rehe to serve.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, because the river broke at Hehuatang, Hengte was blamed for poor management and again sent to Rehe to serve.

sentences.zh: 未幾，复釋還，授主事。

translations.literal: Before long he was released again and appointed a secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was released again and appointed a secretary.

sentences.zh: 十五年，選戶部主事，擢直隸永定河道。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was selected as a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue and promoted to intendant of the Yongding River in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was selected as a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue and promoted to intendant of the Yongding River in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 未幾，复授河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Before long he was again appointed Governor-General of the Eastern River Works.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was again appointed governor-general of the Eastern River Works.

sentences.zh: 十六年，奏南糧到通州剝運不能迅速，請在楊村全數起剝，下倉場侍郎玉寧、戴均元等議駁。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he memorialized that southern grain reaching Tongzhou could not be lightered quickly enough and asked that all lightering begin at Yangcun; Vice Ministers Yu Ning and Dai Junyuan of the granary directorate and others deliberated and rejected it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he memorialized that southern grain reaching Tongzhou could not be lightered quickly enough and asked that all lightering begin at Yangcun. Vice Ministers Yu Ning and Dai Junyuan of the granary directorate and others deliberated and rejected the proposal.

sentences.zh: 上責亨特冒昧，下吏議降調，命留任。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked Hengte for rashness; subordinates proposed demotion, but he was ordered to remain at his post.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked Hengte for rashness. Subordinates proposed demotion, but he was ordered to remain at his post.

sentences.zh: 十八年秋，河溢睢寧。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eighteenth year the river overflowed at Suining.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the eighteenth year the river overflowed at Suining.

sentences.zh: 坐奪官，命留工效力。

translations.literal: He was stripped of office and ordered to remain at the works to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: He was stripped of his office and ordered to remain at the works to redeem himself through service.

sentences.zh: 十九年，河道總督吳璥奏微山湖存水僅一二尺，南陽、昭陽、獨山諸湖淤成平陸，無水可導。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year River Works Governor-General Wu Jiong memorialized that Weishan Lake held only one or two feet of water, and Nanyang, Zhaoyang, Dushan, and other lakes were silted into level land with no water to divert.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year river works governor-general Wu Jiong memorialized that Weishan Lake held only one or two feet of water, and Nanyang, Zhaoyang, Dushan, and other lakes were silted into level land with no water to divert.

sentences.zh: 上責亨特在官不能預籌，又聞亨特既奪官居濟寧，仍用總河儀制，斥亨特玩誤縱恣，命逮下刑部治罪，籍其家，刑部議發新疆。

translations.literal: The emperor blamed Hengte for failing to plan ahead while in office, and also heard that though stripped of office he lived at Jining and still used the governor-general's insignia; he denounced Hengte for negligence and indulgence, ordered arrest and trial by the Ministry of Punishments, confiscation of his property; the ministry proposed exile to Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor blamed Hengte for failing to plan ahead while in office and also heard that though stripped of office he lived at Jining and still used the governor-general's insignia. He denounced Hengte for negligence and indulgence, ordered his arrest and trial by the Ministry of Punishments, and confiscation of his property. The ministry proposed exile to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 上命在部荷校半年，發黑龍江效力。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered him cangued at the ministry for half a year, then sent to Heilongjiang to serve.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered him cangued at the ministry for half a year, then sent to Heilongjiang to serve.

sentences.zh: 二十年，卒於戍所。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he died at his place of exile.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he died at his place of exile.

sentences.zh: =何煟=何煟，字謙之，浙江山陰人，先世籍湖南靖州。

translations.literal: He Wei, styled Qianzhi, a native of Shanyin in Zhejiang; his ancestors were registered in Jingzhou in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He Wei, whose courtesy name was Qianzhi, came from Shanyin in Zhejiang; his ancestors had been registered in Jingzhou in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 雍正中，入貲授州同，效力江南河工。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng reign he purchased office as assistant prefect and served on the Jiangnan river works.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongzheng reign he purchased office as an assistant prefect and served on the Jiangnan river works.

sentences.zh: 從大學士河道總督嵇曾筠修浙江尖山海塘，請補杭州東塘同知，避本籍，仍發江南河工。

translations.literal: He followed Grand Secretary and River Works Governor-General Ji Zengyun in repairing the Jianshan sea dike in Zhejiang, asked to be appointed vice-prefect of the eastern dike at Hangzhou, avoided his native place, and was again sent to the Jiangnan river works.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Grand Secretary and river works governor-general Ji Zengyun in repairing the Jianshan sea dike in Zhejiang, asked to be appointed vice-prefect of the eastern dike at Hangzhou, avoided his native place as required, and was again sent to the Jiangnan river works.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，權豐碭通判，授桃源同知。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong he acted as vice-prefect of Feng and Dang and was appointed vice-prefect of Taoyuan.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Qianlong reign he acted as vice-prefect of Feng and Dang and was appointed vice-prefect of Taoyuan.

sentences.zh: 十五年，擢河庫道。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was promoted to intendant of the river treasury.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was promoted to intendant of the river treasury.

sentences.zh: 十六年，遷兩淮鹽運使，特敕兼管河務，以母憂去官。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to salt transport commissioner of the Two Huai and specially ordered to oversee river affairs concurrently; he left office on his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to salt transport commissioner of the Two Huai and specially ordered to oversee river affairs concurrently. He left office when his mother died.

sentences.zh: 十九年，尚書劉統勳等奏論河庫帑項不清，奪煟官，擬徒，追償，拘留工次，久乃繳完免罪。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Minister Liu Tongxun and others memorialized that river-treasury accounts were unclear; Wei was stripped of office, sentenced to penal servitude with restitution, detained at the works, and only after long payment was he spared punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year Minister Liu Tongxun and others memorialized that river-treasury accounts were unclear. Wei was stripped of office, sentenced to penal servitude with restitution, and detained at the works. Only after he had paid in full over a long period was he spared further punishment.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，仍發南河以同知用。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was again sent to the Southern River Works for use as vice-prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was again sent to the Southern River Works for use as a vice-prefect.

sentences.zh: 從侍郎夢麟疏濬荊山橋河工。

translations.literal: He followed Vice Minister Menglin in dredging the Jingshan Bridge river works.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Vice Minister Meng Lin in dredging the Jingshan Bridge river works.

sentences.zh: 從副總河嵇璜治淮、揚河務，超擢淮揚道。

translations.literal: He followed Deputy Governor-General Ji Huang in managing Huai and Yang river affairs and was exceptionally promoted to the Huai-Yang circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He followed deputy governor-general Ji Huang in managing Huai and Yang river affairs and was exceptionally promoted to the Huai-Yang circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，丁父憂，總督尹繼善奏留在任守制，許之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, upon his father's death, Governor-General Yin Jishan memorialized to keep him at his post to observe mourning, and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, upon his father's death, governor-general Yin Jishan memorialized to keep him at his post to observe mourning, and this was granted.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，以郎中內調。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was transferred within the capital as a director.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he was transferred within the capital as a director.

sentences.zh: 會河決中牟楊橋，上命大學士劉統勳等蒞工，以胃從。

translations.literal: When the river broke at Yangqiao in Zhongmou, the emperor ordered Grand Secretary Liu Tongxun and others to the works, with Wei accompanying.
translations.idiomatic: When the river broke at Yangqiao in Zhongmou, the emperor ordered Grand Secretary Liu Tongxun and others to the works, with Wei accompanying them.

sentences.zh: 工竟，留煟駐工防護。

translations.literal: When the work was finished, Wei was left stationed at the works for protection.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was finished, Wei was left stationed at the works for protection.

sentences.zh: 旋授開歸陳許道，調山東運河道。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed to the Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu circuit and transferred to intendant of the Shandong transport canal.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed to the Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu circuit and transferred to intendant of the Shandong transport canal.

sentences.zh: 三十年，調河南河北道，擢按察使。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was transferred to the Hebei circuit in Henan and promoted to surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he was transferred to the Hebei circuit in Henan and promoted to surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 上以煟習河事，命兼領河工。

translations.literal: Because Wei was versed in river affairs, the emperor ordered him to oversee river works concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Because Wei was versed in river affairs, the emperor ordered him to oversee river works concurrently.

sentences.zh: 煟信浮屠說，讞獄輒從輕比，睢州民劉玉樹謀殺人，鞫實，擬斬候，刑部改立決。

translations.literal: Wei believed Buddhist teachings and in judging cases often applied lighter penalties; Liu Yushu of Suizhou plotted murder; the facts were established and decapitation after review was proposed, but the Ministry of Punishments changed it to immediate execution.
translations.idiomatic: Wei believed Buddhist teachings and in judging cases often applied lighter penalties. Liu Yushu of Suizhou had plotted murder; the facts were established and decapitation after review was proposed, but the Ministry of Punishments changed it to immediate execution.

sentences.zh: 上責煟寬縱，諮巡撫阿思哈，阿思哈稱其能勝任。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked Wei for leniency and consulted Governor Asiha, who said he was capable.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked Wei for leniency and consulted Governor Asiha, who said he was capable.

sentences.zh: 其冬，擢布政使，仍兼理河務。

translations.literal: That winter he was promoted to provincial administration commissioner and still managed river affairs concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he was promoted to provincial administration commissioner and still managed river affairs concurrently.

sentences.zh: 兩權巡撫。

translations.literal: He twice acted as governor.
translations.idiomatic: He twice served as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，授巡撫，兼河務如故。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he was appointed governor, with river affairs as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year he was appointed governor, with river affairs as before.

sentences.zh: 尋又命兼領山東河道。

translations.literal: Soon he was also ordered to oversee the Shandong river works concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was also ordered to oversee the Shandong river works concurrently.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，淅川、內鄉被水，正陽、確山風災，疏請撫卹緩徵，上賜詩，褒以「愛民知政」。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year Xichuan and Neixiang were flooded, and Zhengyang and Queshan suffered wind disaster; he memorialized for relief, tax deferral, and exemption; the emperor granted a poem praising him with "loving the people and knowing governance."
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year Xichuan and Neixiang were flooded, and Zhengyang and Queshan suffered wind damage. He memorialized for relief, tax deferral, and exemption. The emperor granted a poem praising him with the phrase "loving the people and knowing governance."

sentences.zh: 三十八年，上巡天津，閱永定河工，煟迎駕，賜孔雀翎、黃馬褂。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year the emperor toured Tianjin and inspected Yongding River works; Wei welcomed the imperial procession and was granted a peacock feather and yellow jacket.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year the emperor toured Tianjin and inspected Yongding River works. Wei welcomed the imperial procession and was granted a peacock feather and a yellow jacket.

sentences.zh: 尋命與工部尚書裘曰修、直隸總督周元理勘永定河上游，疏言：「永定河挾沙而行，散漫無定。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered with Minister of Works Qiu Yixiu and Zhili Governor Zhou Yuanli to survey the upper Yongding River; he memorialized: "The Yongding River carries sand as it flows and wanders without fixed course.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was ordered with Minister of Works Qiu Yixiu and Zhili governor Zhou Yuanli to survey the upper Yongding River. He memorialized: "The Yongding River carries sand as it flows and wanders without a fixed course.

sentences.zh: 水性就下，本無不同；

translations.literal: Water by nature seeks the lower level and is fundamentally the same;
translations.idiomatic: Water by nature seeks the lower level and is fundamentally the same;

sentences.zh: 而地有高卑，沙有通塞，情因時而或異。

translations.literal: but ground has high and low, sand has open and blocked passages, and conditions differ with the times.
translations.idiomatic: but the ground has high and low places, sand has open and blocked passages, and conditions differ with the times.

sentences.zh: 永定河遷徙不定，其情也，非其性也。

translations.literal: The Yongding River's shifting course is a matter of conditions, not its nature.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding River's shifting course is a matter of conditions, not its nature.

sentences.zh: 察其情，導其性，先宣后防，千古極則，雖起神禹，無以易之。

translations.literal: Observe its conditions, guide its nature, first discharge then defend—this eternal principle, even if Yu the Divine arose, could not be changed.
translations.idiomatic: Observe its conditions, guide its nature, first discharge and then defend—this eternal principle could not be changed even if Yu the Divine arose again.

sentences.zh: 永定河下口，蒙皇上指示疏導，既不阻下達之勢，更可免浸潤之虞，其法固當常守。

translations.literal: At the lower mouth of the Yongding River, following the emperor's instruction to dredge and guide, it neither blocks downward flow nor risks seepage; this method should be permanently maintained.
translations.idiomatic: At the lower mouth of the Yongding River, following the emperor's instruction to dredge and guide, it neither blocks downward flow nor risks seepage. This method should be permanently maintained.

sentences.zh: 所慮數十年後，妄生異論，別騁新奇，勢且變亂舊章，貽河防巨患。

translations.literal: What is feared is that decades hence reckless new opinions and novel schemes will overturn the old regulations and bring great calamity to river defense.
translations.idiomatic: What is feared is that decades hence reckless new opinions and novel schemes will overturn the old regulations and bring great calamity to river defense.

sentences.zh: 請將聖諭並議言條款勒碑垂久遠。」

translations.literal: I ask that the imperial edict and the provisions of this memorial be carved on stone to endure."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the imperial edict and the provisions of this memorial be carved on stone to endure."

sentences.zh: 報聞。

translations.literal: This was reported and noted.
translations.idiomatic: This was reported and noted.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，疏請各州縣常平倉溢額以四千石為限，餘循例變價。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year he memorialized that surplus in each prefecture and county ever-normal granary be limited to four thousand shi, with the rest sold at market price as usual.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year he memorialized that surplus in each prefecture and county ever-normal granary be limited to four thousand shi, with the rest sold at market price as usual.

sentences.zh: 又奏河南漕穀七十九萬、薊米二十九萬，分存各州縣界。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that Henan's transport grain of 790,000 and Ji grain of 290,000 be stored separately at each prefecture and county boundary.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized that Henan's transport grain of 790,000 and Ji grain of 290,000 be stored separately at each prefecture and county boundary.

sentences.zh: 鄰省安陽等五州縣限二萬石、近水次祥符等三十五州縣限一萬石。

translations.literal: Neighboring Anyang and four other prefectures and counties were limited to twenty thousand shi; thirty-five prefectures and counties near water stations such as Xiangfu were limited to ten thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: Neighboring Anyang and four other prefectures and counties were limited to twenty thousand shi; thirty-five prefectures and counties near water stations such as Xiangfu were limited to ten thousand shi.

sentences.zh: 均如所擬。

translations.literal: All were approved as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved as proposed.

sentences.zh: 加總督銜，仍領河南巡撫，又進兵部尚書銜。

translations.literal: He was given the rank of governor-general while still leading Henan as governor, and further advanced to the rank of Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the rank of governor-general while still leading Henan as governor, and further advanced to the rank of minister of war.

sentences.zh: 其秋，會剿王倫，事平，道內黃，病作。

translations.literal: That autumn he joined in suppressing Wang Lun; when the affair was settled he passed through Neihuang and fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he joined in suppressing Wang Lun. When the affair was settled he passed through Neihuang and fell ill.

sentences.zh: 遣醫往視，未至，卒。

translations.literal: A physician was sent to attend him, but before arrival he died.
translations.idiomatic: A physician was sent to attend him, but before the physician arrived he died.

sentences.zh: 煟贈太子太保，祀賢良祠，賜祭葬，諡恭惠。

translations.literal: Wei was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, enshrined in the Shrine of Worthy Officials, granted funeral rites, and given the posthumous name Gonghui.
translations.idiomatic: Wei was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, enshrined in the Shrine of Worthy Officials, granted funeral rites, and given the posthumous name Gonghui.

sentences.zh: 裕城，煟子，字福天。

translations.literal: Yucheng was Wei's son, styled Futian.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng was Wei's son; his courtesy name was Futian.

sentences.zh: 自貢生入貲授道員。

translations.literal: From tribute student he purchased office as a circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: From tribute student he purchased office as a circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十二年，除山東督糧道。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year of Qianlong he was appointed intendant of grain transport in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year of Qianlong he was appointed intendant of grain transport in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 調河南河北道。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Hebei circuit in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Hebei circuit in Henan.

sentences.zh: 河溢儀封，大學士高晉工，以裕城從。

translations.literal: The river overflowed at Yifeng; Grand Secretary Gao Jin took charge of the works, with Yucheng accompanying.
translations.idiomatic: The river overflowed at Yifeng. Grand Secretary Gao Jin took charge of the works, with Yucheng accompanying him.

sentences.zh: 儀封埽工蟄陷，坐奪官，命留任。

translations.literal: The mat works at Yifeng sank; he was stripped of office but ordered to remain at his post.
translations.idiomatic: The mat works at Yifeng sank. He was stripped of his office but ordered to remain at his post.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，調江南河庫道。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year he was transferred to the Jiangnan river treasury circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year he was transferred to the Jiangnan river treasury circuit.

sentences.zh: 裕城侍煟治河，嘗著全河指要，謂：「治河當節宣並用，不當泥河不兩行之說，偏於節束。」

translations.literal: Yucheng attended Wei in managing rivers and once wrote Essentials of the Whole River, saying: "River control should use both regulation and discharge together; one should not cling to the saying that a river cannot run in two channels and be partial to restraint alone."
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng had attended Wei in managing rivers and once wrote Essentials of the Whole River, in which he said: "River control should combine regulation and discharge; one should not cling to the saying that a river cannot run in two channels and rely on restraint alone."

sentences.zh: 並上書當事，指陳南北岸諸險工。

translations.literal: He also wrote to those in authority, pointing out the dangerous works on both north and south banks.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote to those in authority, pointing out the dangerous works on both the north and south banks.

sentences.zh: 未幾，河決青龍岡，注微山湖，衝運河。

translations.literal: Before long the river broke at Qinglonggang, poured into Weishan Lake, and struck the canal.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the river broke at Qinglonggang, poured into Weishan Lake, and struck the canal.

sentences.zh: 四十七年七月，河東河道總督韓鑅丁憂，青龍岡工未竟，上特命裕城署理。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the forty-seventh year Eastern River Governor-General Han Heng entered mourning; the Qinglonggang work was unfinished, and the emperor specially ordered Yucheng to act in his place.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the forty-seventh year Eastern River governor-general Han Heng entered mourning while the Qinglonggang work was still unfinished. The emperor specially ordered Yucheng to act in his place.

sentences.zh: 大學士阿桂視工曲家樓，請自蘭陽至商丘別築新堤。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Agui inspected the works at Qujialou and proposed building a new dike separately from Lanyang to Shangqiu.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Agui inspected the works at Qujialou and proposed building a new dike separately from Lanyang to Shangqiu.

sentences.zh: 裕城奏：「蘭陽新開引河，其上游素稱險要，必須內有重障，外有挑護。

translations.literal: Yucheng memorialized: "The newly opened diversion at Lanyang has an upstream long called dangerous; there must be a strong barrier within and protective works without.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng memorialized: "The newly opened diversion at Lanyang has an upstream long known as dangerous. There must be a strong barrier within and protective works without.

sentences.zh: 大堤後舊有越堤，相去遠，恐不足恃。

translations.literal: Behind the main dike there is an old overflow dike, but it is far away and may not be relied upon.
translations.idiomatic: Behind the main dike there is an old overflow dike, but it is far away and may not be relied upon.

sentences.zh: 請向東添築格堤，臨河近溜處加築挑水壩。」

translations.literal: I ask that a retaining dike be added to the east and spillway dams built where the current runs close to the river."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that a retaining dike be added to the east and spillway dams built where the current runs close to the river."

sentences.zh: 上從之。

translations.literal: The emperor adopted this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor adopted this.

sentences.zh: 又奏兗州伊家河在運河八閘之西，以分洩運河及瀕湖諸水，應挑展寬深，上命速興工。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that the Yijia River at Yanzhou lies west of the canal's eight sluices and diverts canal and lake-margin waters; it should be dredged wider and deeper; the emperor ordered work begun quickly.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized that the Yijia River at Yanzhou lies west of the canal's eight sluices and diverts canal and lake-margin waters. It should be dredged wider and deeper, and the emperor ordered work begun quickly.

sentences.zh: 又奏伊家河興工後，即往河南勘驗引水子溝；

translations.literal: He also memorialized that after work on the Yijia River began he would go to Henan to survey the Zishui diversion ditch;
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized that after work on the Yijia River began he would go to Henan to survey the Zishui diversion ditch;

sentences.zh: 仍往來山東、河南督察：上嘉之，並諭曰：「汝若能不自滿而加以勤學，或可繼汝父也。」

translations.literal: and would still travel between Shandong and Henan to supervise: the emperor praised this and also instructed: "If you can avoid self-satisfaction and study diligently, you may perhaps follow your father."
translations.idiomatic: and would still travel between Shandong and Henan to supervise. The emperor praised this and also instructed him: "If you can avoid self-satisfaction and study diligently, you may perhaps follow your father."

sentences.zh: 伊家河工竟，四十八年，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: When the Yijia River work was finished, in the forty-eighth year he was granted a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yijia River work was finished, in the forty-eighth year he was granted a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 是年，青龍岡工竟，請修築運河堤岸，詣濟寧勘估，奏需帑六十四萬有奇，得旨允行。

translations.literal: That year the Qinglonggang work was finished; he asked to repair canal dikes, went to Jining to survey and estimate, memorialized that over 640,000 taels were needed, and received approval.
