translations.idiomatic: That year the Qinglonggang work was finished. He asked to repair the canal dikes, went to Jining to survey and estimate, memorialized that a little over 640,000 taels were needed, and received approval.

sentences.zh: 授河南巡撫。

translations.literal: He was appointed Governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 以秋審多失出，降三品頂帶，停支養廉。

translations.literal: Because autumn review released too many convicts, he was demoted to third-rank insignia and his integrity stipend was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Because the autumn judicial review released too many convicts, he was demoted to third-rank insignia and his integrity stipend was suspended.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，運河堤岸工竟，命議敘。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year the canal dike work was finished and he was ordered considered for reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year the canal dike work was finished and he was ordered considered for reward.

sentences.zh: 師討石峰堡亂回，道河南，裕城佐軍興，复頂帶、養廉。

translations.literal: When the army suppressed the rebellion at Shifeng Fort and passed through Henan, Yucheng assisted military supply; his insignia and stipend were restored.
translations.idiomatic: When the army suppressed the rebellion at Shifeng Fort and passed through Henan, Yucheng assisted military supply. His insignia and stipend were restored.

sentences.zh: 五十年，調陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year he was transferred to Governor of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year he was transferred to governor of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 朝邑被水，上諭裕城就被水處將淤積泥沙建築河堤。

translations.literal: Chaoyi was flooded; the emperor instructed Yucheng to use silted sand and mud at the flooded place to build river dikes.
translations.idiomatic: Chaoyi was flooded. The emperor instructed Yucheng to use the silted sand and mud at the flooded site to build river dikes.

sentences.zh: 尋奏創建護城隄，下部議行。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized to build a protective city dike; this was referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he memorialized to build a protective city dike. The proposal was referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 調江西巡撫，五十二年，奏江西河路二千四百餘裡，請以所獲盜舟改設巡船，上嘉之。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Governor of Jiangxi; in the fifty-second year he memorialized that Jiangxi's river routes exceed 2,400 li and asked that captured pirate boats be converted to patrol vessels; the emperor praised this.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to governor of Jiangxi. In the fifty-second year he memorialized that Jiangxi's river routes exceed 2,400 li and asked that captured pirate boats be converted to patrol vessels. The emperor praised this.

sentences.zh: 又奏豐城鎮平堤中段水勢衝激，不足捍禦，請改建石隄，從之。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that the middle section of the Zhenping dike at Fengcheng was struck by the current and insufficient to hold; he asked to rebuild it in stone, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized that the middle section of the Zhenping dike at Fengcheng was struck by the current and insufficient to hold. He asked to rebuild it in stone, and this was approved.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，調安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year he was transferred to Governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year he was transferred to governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 命來京祝八旬萬壽，行次合肥，卒。

translations.literal: He was ordered to the capital to celebrate the emperor's eightieth birthday; en route at Hefei he died.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to the capital to celebrate the emperor's eightieth birthday. En route at Hefei he died.

sentences.zh: =吳嗣爵=吳嗣爵，字樹屏，浙江錢塘人。

translations.literal: Wu Sijue, styled Shuping, a native of Qiantang in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sijue, whose courtesy name was Shuping, came from Qiantang in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 八歲而孤，母錢督之嚴，雍正八年成進士。

translations.literal: Orphaned at eight, his mother Qian supervised him strictly; in the eighth year of Yongzheng he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned at eight, he was supervised strictly by his mother, née Qian. In the eighth year of Yongzheng he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 授禮部主事，大學士張廷玉奏改吏部。

translations.literal: He was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Rites; Grand Secretary Zhang Tingyu memorialized to transfer him to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Rites. Grand Secretary Zhang Tingyu memorialized to transfer him to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 再遷郎中。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to director.
translations.idiomatic: He was again promoted to director.

sentences.zh: 嗣爵彊識，嫺故事。

translations.literal: Sijue had a strong memory and was skilled in precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Sijue had a strong memory and was skilled in precedent.

sentences.zh: 乾隆六年，授常州知府，再授保寧，皆奏留部。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Qianlong he was appointed prefect of Changzhou and again of Baoning; both times he was memorialized to remain at the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Qianlong he was appointed prefect of Changzhou and again of Baoning; both times he was memorialized to remain at the ministry.

sentences.zh: 旋命視學湖北，調福建。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to serve as educational commissioner in Hubei and was transferred to Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was ordered to serve as educational commissioner in Hubei and was transferred to Fujian.

sentences.zh: 十三年，授淮安知府，遷淮揚道。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was appointed prefect of Huai'an and promoted to the Huai-Yang circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was appointed prefect of Huai'an and promoted to the Huai-Yang circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪澤湖盛漲，例當開天然壩。

translations.literal: Hongze Lake rose greatly; by precedent the Natural Dam should be opened.
translations.idiomatic: Hongze Lake rose greatly. By precedent the Natural Dam should be opened.

sentences.zh: 嗣爵曰：「開壩減暴漲，如下河州縣生靈何？」

translations.literal: Sijue said: "Opening the dam reduces sudden floods, but what of the people in the lower-river prefectures and counties?"
translations.idiomatic: Sijue said: "Opening the dam reduces sudden floods, but what of the people in the lower-river prefectures and counties?"

sentences.zh: 持之力，卒無恙。

translations.literal: He held firm, and in the end there was no harm.
translations.idiomatic: He held firm, and in the end there was no harm.

sentences.zh: 十六年，調兩淮鹽運使。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to salt transport commissioner of the Two Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to salt transport commissioner of the Two Huai.

sentences.zh: 十八年，复授淮揚道，遭母憂，上諭曰：「防河官吏叢弊，故特由運使調用。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was again appointed to the Huai-Yang circuit; upon his mother's death the emperor instructed: "River-defense officials are rife with abuses, hence the special transfer from salt commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was again appointed to the Huai-Yang circuit. Upon his mother's death the emperor instructed: "River-defense officials are rife with abuses, hence the special transfer from the salt commissioner.

sentences.zh: 河工與地方官吏不同，畀假兩月治喪，畢，在任守制。」

translations.literal: River works differ from local officials; grant two months' leave for mourning, then observe mourning without leaving the post."
translations.idiomatic: River works differ from local officials. Grant two months' leave for mourning, then observe mourning without leaving the post."

sentences.zh: 擢江蘇按察使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to judicial commissioner of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to judicial commissioner of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 遷布政使，調湖南，未行，奏江寧等三十五州縣積欠應徵口糧，請特旨緩徵。

translations.literal: He was transferred to provincial administration commissioner and ordered to Hunan; before departing he memorialized that thirty-five prefectures and counties including Jiangning had accumulated arrears of grain tax and asked special deferral.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to provincial administration commissioner and ordered to Hunan. Before departing he memorialized that thirty-five prefectures and counties including Jiangning had accumulated arrears of grain tax and asked for special deferral.

sentences.zh: 上諮巡撫託恩多，託恩多奏江寧等州縣年豐，不當再請緩徵。

translations.literal: The emperor consulted Governor Tuo Enduo, who memorialized that Jiangning and other prefectures and counties had good harvests and should not again request deferral.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor consulted Governor Tuo Enduo, who memorialized that Jiangning and other prefectures and counties had good harvests and should not again request deferral.

sentences.zh: 上責嗣爵藉緩徵卸過，並為有司催徵不力地，命發江南河工，以同知用。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked Sijue for using deferral to shift blame and making a pretext of officials' weak collection; he was sent to the Jiangnan river works for use as vice-prefect.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked Sijue for using deferral to shift blame and for making a pretext of officials' weak collection. He was sent to the Jiangnan river works for use as a vice-prefect.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，補宿虹同知，仍授淮揚道，移淮徐道。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was appointed vice-prefect of Suqian and Hongze, again given the Huai-Yang circuit, and transferred to the Huai-Xu circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he was appointed vice-prefect of Suqian and Hongze, again given the Huai-Yang circuit, and transferred to the Huai-Xu circuit.

sentences.zh: 黃河盛漲，逼徐家莊縷堤，嗣爵督吏搶護，命署理河東河道總督。

translations.literal: The Yellow River rose greatly and pressed the thread dike at Xujiazhuang; Sijue supervised officials in emergency repair and was ordered to act as Eastern River Governor-General.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River rose greatly and pressed the thread dike at Xujiazhuang. Sijue supervised officials in emergency repair and was ordered to act as Eastern River governor-general.

sentences.zh: 旋坐官運使時商人侵蝕提引公費，坐降調，命改奪官，仍留任。

translations.literal: Soon, for embezzling public fees for transport and salt while salt commissioner, he was proposed for demotion; the order was changed to stripping office while he remained at his post.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, for embezzling public fees for transport and salt while serving as salt commissioner, he was proposed for demotion. The order was changed to stripping him of his rank while he remained at his post.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，奏請修補丁廟、六里、南旺、荊門、戴村諸閘壩，並言：「運河兩岸土工，臨清以北為民堰，南旺以南為官堤，自臨清至南旺，官堤、民堰交錯。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he memorialized to repair the sluices and dams at Dingmiao, Liuli, Nanwang, Jingmen, and Daicun, and said: "Earthen works on both banks of the canal: north of Linqing are civilian dikes, south of Nanwang are official dikes; from Linqing to Nanwang official and civilian works alternate.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year he memorialized to repair the sluices and dams at Dingmiao, Liuli, Nanwang, Jingmen, and Daicun, and said: "Earthen works on both banks of the canal: north of Linqing are civilian dikes, south of Nanwang are official dikes. From Linqing to Nanwang official and civilian works alternate.

sentences.zh: 請凡民堰卑薄殘缺處，督令修築，官堤酌緩急次第培修。」

translations.literal: I ask that wherever civilian dikes are low, thin, or broken they be ordered repaired, and official dikes be strengthened in order of urgency."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that wherever civilian dikes are low, thin, or broken they be ordered repaired, and official dikes be strengthened in order of urgency."

sentences.zh: 上嘉之。

translations.literal: The emperor praised this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised this.

sentences.zh: 署河南巡撫。

translations.literal: He acted as Governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He served as acting governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，奏：「南旺湖北高南下，在運河西岸，值分水口之衝。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year he memorialized: "Nanwang Lake is high in the north and low in the south, on the west bank of the canal, at the division point.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year he memorialized: "Nanwang Lake is high in the north and low in the south, on the west bank of the canal, at the division point.

sentences.zh: 伏秋汶水發，自關家、常鳴等斗門灌入，祗能收水入湖，不能出水濟運。

translations.literal: In dog days and autumn when the Wen River rises, water enters through the Guanjia, Changming, and other sluices and can only be stored in the lake, not released to supply transport.
translations.idiomatic: In midsummer and autumn when the Wen River rises, water enters through the Guanjia, Changming, and other sluices and can only be stored in the lake, not released to supply transport.

sentences.zh: 請於南旺下游土地廟前增建石閘一，以時啟閉。」

translations.literal: I ask that one stone sluice be added downstream at Tudi Temple before Nanwang, opened and closed as needed."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that one stone sluice be added downstream at Tudi Temple before Nanwang, opened and closed as needed."

sentences.zh: 三十六年，遷江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he was transferred to Governor-General of the Jiangnan River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year he was transferred to governor-general of the Jiangnan River Works.

sentences.zh: 四十年，奏：「丁家集黃河自北趨南，北岸新灘插入河心，致衝漫南岸民堰五百餘丈。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year he memorialized: "At Dingjiaji the Yellow River runs from north to south; a new shoal on the north bank thrust into the river center and washed away over five hundred zhang of the south-bank civilian dike.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year he memorialized: "At Dingjiaji the Yellow River runs from north to south. A new shoal on the north bank thrust into the river center and washed away over five hundred zhang of the south-bank civilian dike.

sentences.zh: 毛城鋪過水較大，下流亦不能容。

translations.literal: At Maochengpu the overflow is large and the lower course also cannot hold it.
translations.idiomatic: At Maochengpu the overflow is large and the lower course also cannot hold it.

sentences.zh: 今收正河頭，測量河脣，濬引渠，築子壩，於北岸旁黃河故道濬引河，來春相機開放，俾河改由北岸東下，不使旁注丁家集諸地。」

translations.literal: Now gather the main river head, measure the river lip, dredge diversion channels, build subsidiary dams, and dredge a diversion in the old Yellow River channel on the north bank; next spring open as conditions allow so the river turns east along the north bank and does not pour into Dingjiaji and other places."
translations.idiomatic: Now gather the main river head, measure the river lip, dredge diversion channels, build subsidiary dams, and dredge a diversion in the old Yellow River channel on the north bank. Next spring open it as conditions allow so that the river turns east along the north bank and does not pour into Dingjiaji and other places."

sentences.zh: 又奏：「里河廳運口本設惠濟、通濟、福興三閘，惠濟尤為淮水入運關鍵，請俟春融修築。」

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "At the inner-canal transport mouth there were originally the Huiji, Tongji, and Fuxing sluices; Huiji is especially the key for Huai water entering the canal; I ask that repair wait until spring thaw."
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "At the inner-canal transport mouth there were originally the Huiji, Tongji, and Fuxing sluices. Huiji is especially the key for Huai water entering the canal. I ask that repair wait until spring thaw."

sentences.zh: 四十一年，又奏清口通湖引河凡五，為洪澤湖尾閭，並分別籌濬，運道以濟。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year he again memorialized that Qingkou has five diversion channels to the lake, the tail of Hongze Lake, each to be dredged separately so the transport route may be supplied.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year he again memorialized that Qingkou has five diversion channels to the lake—the tail of Hongze Lake—each to be dredged separately so that the transport route may be supplied.

sentences.zh: 尋奏五引河中張家莊、裴家場二河水洩，應濬使寬深，從之。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized that among the five diversions, Zhangjiazhuang and Peijiachang leak water and should be dredged wider and deeper; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he memorialized that among the five diversions, Zhangjiazhuang and Peijiachang leak water and should be dredged wider and deeper. This was approved.

sentences.zh: 是年，上東巡，嗣爵覲行在，入對，不能興，左右掖以出。

translations.literal: That year, during the emperor's eastern tour, Sijue presented himself at the traveling palace, entered audience, could not rise, and was supported out by attendants.
translations.idiomatic: That year, during the emperor's eastern tour, Sijue presented himself at the traveling palace and entered audience. He could not rise and was supported out by attendants on either side.

sentences.zh: 改吏部侍郎，四十二年，乞罷，歸。

translations.literal: He was changed to Vice Minister of Personnel; in the forty-second year he begged to retire and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed to vice minister of personnel. In the forty-second year he begged to retire and returned home.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，卒，年七十有三。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year he died, aged seventy-three.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year he died, aged seventy-three.

sentences.zh: 子璥，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Jin has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jin has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: =薩載=薩載，伊爾根覺羅氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Sa Zai, of the Irgen Gioro clan, a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Zai, of the Irgen Gioro clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 父薩哈岱，官鑲藍旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: His father Sahadai served as Manchu vice commander of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: His father Sahadai served as Manchu vice commander of the Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 薩載，繙譯舉人，授理籓院筆帖式。

translations.literal: Sa Zai, a translation licentiate, was appointed a clerk in the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Zai, a translation licentiate, was appointed a clerk in the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 累遷江蘇蘇松太道，管蘇州織造。

translations.literal: He was promoted to the Su-Song-Tai circuit in Jiangsu and managed Suzhou weaving.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to the Su-Song-Tai circuit in Jiangsu and managed Suzhou weaving.

sentences.zh: 果親王弘適短價令制繡緞朝衣，事發，奪官。

translations.literal: Prince Guo Hongshi ordered embroidered satin court dress at short price; when the matter came out, Zai was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Guo Hongshi ordered embroidered satin court dress at a short price. When the matter came out, Zai was stripped of his office.

sentences.zh: 召還京，予主事銜。

translations.literal: He was recalled to the capital and given the rank of secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to the capital and given the rank of secretary.

sentences.zh: 尋授薩哈岱蘇州織造，命薩載侍行為佐。

translations.literal: Soon Sahadai was appointed Suzhou weaving commissioner and Sa Zai was ordered to accompany him as assistant.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Sahadai was appointed Suzhou weaving commissioner and Sa Zai was ordered to accompany him as assistant.

sentences.zh: 逾年，改授普福，命交兩江總督差委。

translations.literal: After a year Pufu was appointed instead, and Zai was ordered assigned by the Two Jiangs governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: After a year Pufu was appointed instead, and Zai was ordered assigned by the Two Jiangs governor-general.

sentences.zh: 旋授松江知府。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed prefect of Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed prefect of Songjiang.

sentences.zh: ，加道銜，复署蘇州織造。

translations.literal: He was given circuit rank and again acted as Suzhou weaving commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was given circuit rank and again served as acting Suzhou weaving commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，擢江蘇布政使，仍兼織造。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he was promoted to provincial administration commissioner of Jiangsu, still overseeing weaving concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year he was promoted to provincial administration commissioner of Jiangsu, still overseeing weaving concurrently.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，署巡撫。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year he acted as governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year he served as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 巡撫永德請以華亭、寶山土塘改建條石，薩載言條石易傾圮。

translations.literal: Governor Yongde asked to rebuild the earthen dikes at Huating and Baoshan in strip stone; Sa Zai said strip stone easily collapses.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Yongde asked to rebuild the earthen dikes at Huating and Baoshan in strip stone. Sa Zai said strip stone easily collapses.

sentences.zh: 按察使吳壇請裁巡檢弓兵，增州縣捕役，薩載言不便，皆寢其議。

translations.literal: Surveillance Commissioner Wu Tan asked to cut patrol archers and increase prefecture and county catchers; Sa Zai said this was inconvenient; all proposals were shelved.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance commissioner Wu Tan asked to cut patrol archers and increase prefecture and county catchers. Sa Zai said this was inconvenient. All proposals were shelved.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，與總督高晉奏濬海州河道，又奏江蘇社穀積至三十七萬六千餘石，請察驗，報聞。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, with Governor-General Gao Jin he memorialized to dredge the Haizhou river channel, and also memorialized that Jiangsu community grain had accumulated to over 376,000 shi and asked for inspection; this was reported and noted.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, with governor-general Gao Jin he memorialized to dredge the Haizhou river channel. He also memorialized that Jiangsu community grain had accumulated to over 376,000 shi and asked for inspection. This was reported and noted.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，真除江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year he received substantive appointment as Governor of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year he received substantive appointment as governor of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 上命察屯田，薩載奏江安糧道屬江淮、興武等六衛，蘇州糧道屬蘇州、太倉等四衛，令清釐冊報，循新例四年一編審；

translations.literal: The emperor ordered inspection of military colonies; Sa Zai memorialized that the Jiang'an grain route includes six guards such as Jianghuai and Xingwu, and the Suzhou grain route includes four guards such as Suzhou and Taicang; he ordered clear registers and, under the new rule, review every four years;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered inspection of military colonies. Sa Zai memorialized that the Jiang'an grain route includes six guards such as Jianghuai and Xingwu, and the Suzhou grain route includes four guards such as Suzhou and Taicang. He ordered clear registers and, under the new rule, review every four years;

sentences.zh: 加給江淮、興武二衛屯丁墾田，運丁快丁終歲輓輸，請加給津貼；

translations.literal: for Jianghuai and Xingwu guards he asked additional grants for colony soldiers' reclaimed fields; transport soldiers and express haulers work all year—he asked additional allowances;
translations.idiomatic: for Jianghuai and Xingwu guards he asked additional grants for colony soldiers' reclaimed fields. Transport soldiers and express haulers work all year—he asked for additional allowances;

sentences.zh: 太倉、鎮海二衛田不隨船，私相售典，循舊例借項贖回；

translations.literal: Taicang and Zhenhai guards' fields do not follow the boats and are privately sold or pawned; under the old rule loans should redeem them;
translations.idiomatic: Taicang and Zhenhai guards' fields do not follow the boats and are privately sold or pawned. Under the old rule loans should redeem them;

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，河溢外河廳老壩口，偕河道總督吳嗣爵董工事，未兩旬工竟，議敘。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year the river overflowed at Laobakou in the outer-canal office; with River Works Governor-General Wu Sijue he supervised the works; in less than twenty days the work was finished and he was considered for reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year the river overflowed at Laobakou in the outer-canal office. With river works governor-general Wu Sijue he supervised the works, and in less than twenty days the work was finished. He was considered for reward.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，上東巡，覲行在，授江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year, during the emperor's eastern tour, he presented himself at the traveling palace and was appointed Governor-General of the Jiangnan River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year, during the emperor's eastern tour, he presented himself at the traveling palace and was appointed governor-general of the Jiangnan River Works.

sentences.zh: 命與高晉察黃河海口淤沙。

translations.literal: He was ordered with Gao Jin to inspect silt at the Yellow River estuary.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered with Gao Jin to inspect silt at the Yellow River estuary.

sentences.zh: 薩載先至，奏：「海口前在王家港，自雍正時接湧淤灘，長四十餘裡；

translations.literal: Sa Zai arrived first and memorialized: "The estuary was formerly at Wangjiagang; since Yongzheng silt banks have continuously formed, over forty li long;
translations.idiomatic: Sa Zai arrived first and memorialized: "The estuary was formerly at Wangjiagang. Since the Yongzheng reign silt banks have continuously formed, over forty li long;

sentences.zh: 南岸為新淤尖、為尖頭洋，北岸為二泓、三泓、四泓。

translations.literal: on the south bank are Xinyujian and Jiantouyang; on the north bank are the Second, Third, and Fourth Hong.
translations.idiomatic: on the south bank are Xinyujian and Jiantouyang; on the north bank are the Second, Third, and Fourth Hong.

sentences.zh: 二泓、四泓寬二十餘丈，潮至深二三丈；

translations.literal: the Second and Fourth Hong are over twenty zhang wide, with tide depth of two or three zhang;
translations.idiomatic: The Second and Fourth Hong are over twenty zhang wide, with a tide depth of two or three zhang;

sentences.zh: 三泓寬四十餘丈，潮至深三四丈。

translations.literal: the Third Hong is over forty zhang wide, with tide depth of three or four zhang.
translations.idiomatic: the Third Hong is over forty zhang wide, with tide depth of three or four zhang.

sentences.zh: 河底有高低，河脣又漸遠，淤積巳久，難以施工。」

translations.literal: The river bottom is uneven, the river lip grows ever farther away, silt has accumulated long, and work is difficult."
translations.idiomatic: The river bottom is uneven, the river lip grows ever farther away, silt has accumulated for a long time, and work is difficult."

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「此海口自然之勢，難以人力勝之。」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "This is the estuary's natural condition; human effort cannot overcome it."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "This is the estuary's natural condition; human effort cannot overcome it."

sentences.zh: 尋與高晉奏請以清口東、西壩移建平城台，於陶莊迤上別開引河。

translations.literal: Soon with Gao Jin he memorialized to move the east and west dams at Qingkou to Pingchengtai and open a separate diversion above Taozhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon with Gao Jin he memorialized to move the east and west dams at Qingkou to Pingchengtai and open a separate diversion above Taozhuang.

sentences.zh: 是夏，運河及駱馬湖水漲，薩載督吏防護，上嘉其妥協。

translations.literal: That summer the canal and Luoma Lake rose; Sa Zai supervised officials in defense; the emperor praised his balanced handling.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the canal and Luoma Lake rose. Sa Zai supervised officials in defense, and the emperor praised his balanced handling.

sentences.zh: 尋開陶莊引河，四十二年二月，工竟。

translations.literal: Soon the Taozhuang diversion was opened; in the second month of the forty-second year the work was finished.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Taozhuang diversion was opened. In the second month of the forty-second year the work was finished.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「朕屢次南巡，臨閱清、黃交匯處，慮其倒灌，思引向陶莊北流。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "On my repeated southern tours I inspected where the clear and Yellow rivers meet, fearing backflow and thinking to divert north at Taozhuang.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "On my repeated southern tours I inspected where the clear and Yellow rivers meet, fearing backflow and thinking to divert the current north at Taozhuang.

sentences.zh: 歷任河臣未有能任此者。

translations.literal: Successive river officials could not undertake this.
translations.idiomatic: Successive river officials could not undertake this.

sentences.zh: 昨歲薩載奏請施工，與朕意合。

translations.literal: Last year Sa Zai memorialized to begin work, matching my intent.
translations.idiomatic: Last year Sa Zai memorialized to begin work, matching my intent.

sentences.zh: 據奏工竟，自此黃河離清口較遠，既免黃河倒灌之虞，並收清水刷沙之益，實為全河一大關鍵。

translations.literal: According to the report the work is finished; henceforth the Yellow River is farther from Qingkou, avoiding backflow and gaining the benefit of clear water scouring sand—truly a great key to the whole river.
translations.idiomatic: According to the report the work is finished. Henceforth the Yellow River is farther from Qingkou, avoiding backflow and gaining the benefit of clear water scouring sand—truly a great key to the whole river system.

sentences.zh: 視齊蘇勒例，予騎都尉世職。」

translations.literal: Following the precedent of Qisule, grant a hereditary office as Commandant of Cavalry."
translations.idiomatic: Following the precedent of Qisule, grant a hereditary office as Commandant of Cavalry."

sentences.zh: 入覲，上命於攔黃壩迤上加築壩為重門保障，並於舊有木龍三架迤上增設木龍。

translations.literal: On entering audience the emperor ordered a dam built above the Yellow-blocking dam as a double-gate safeguard, and additional timber dragons set above the three existing frames.
translations.idiomatic: On entering audience the emperor ordered a dam built above the Yellow-blocking dam as a double-gate safeguard, and additional timber dragons set above the three existing frames.

sentences.zh: 薩載回任，奏遵上指料理，上嘉之。

translations.literal: Sa Zai returned to his post, memorialized that he was following the imperial direction, and the emperor praised this.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Zai returned to his post and memorialized that he was following the imperial direction. The emperor praised this.

sentences.zh: 冬，復奏：「新河河面首尾寬窄不同，請於北灘順水勢抽槽，酌留土格。

translations.literal: In winter he again memorialized: "The new river's surface is wide at the ends and narrow in the middle; I ask to cut a channel on the north bank following the current and leave earth partitions as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he again memorialized: "The new river's surface is wide at the ends and narrow in the middle. I ask to cut a channel on the north bank following the current and leave earth partitions as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 俟來年水漲放溜沖刷，使河面首尾寬闊相若。」

translations.literal: Wait until next year when water rises to release the current and scour so the river surface is equally wide at both ends."
translations.idiomatic: Wait until next year when the water rises to release the current and scour so that the river surface is equally wide at both ends."

sentences.zh: 繪圖以進，上覽圖中北岸有新淤，因慮北淤則溜必南趨，識以硃筆，命薩載疏治。

translations.literal: He submitted a map; the emperor saw new silt on the north bank in the map, feared that north silt would drive the current south, marked it in vermilion, and ordered Sa Zai to dredge and manage it.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a map. The emperor saw new silt on the north bank in the map, feared that north silt would drive the current south, marked it in vermilion, and ordered Sa Zai to dredge and manage it.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，奏：「高家馬頭新淤已刷動寬深，彭家馬頭新淤前作柴枕土壩。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year he memorialized: "New silt at Gaojiamatou has been scoured wide and deep; new silt at Pengjiamatou had a brush-and-earth dam built before.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year he memorialized: "New silt at Gaojiamatou has been scoured wide and deep. New silt at Pengjiamatou had a brush-and-earth dam built before.

sentences.zh: 茲於灘面抽槽，候水漲沖刷。」

translations.literal: Now a channel is cut on the bank face to await high water and scour."
translations.idiomatic: Now a channel is cut on the bank face to await high water and scour."

sentences.zh: 旋署兩江總督。

translations.literal: Soon he acted as Governor-General of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he served as acting governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，奏攔黃壩外舊河露淤灘，請於灘面築束水堤為新河保障。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year he memorialized that outside the Yellow-blocking dam the old river exposed a silt bank; he asked to build a water-confining dike on the bank as safeguard for the new river.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year he memorialized that outside the Yellow-blocking dam the old river exposed a silt bank. He asked to build a water-confining dike on the bank as safeguard for the new river.

sentences.zh: 尋實授兩江總督。

translations.literal: Soon he received substantive appointment as Governor-General of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he received substantive appointment as governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 先是，高晉奏中河口門淤阻，議移下游李家莊，上命薩載勘奏。

translations.literal: Earlier Gao Jin memorialized that the Zhonghe River mouth was silt-blocked and proposed moving it downstream to Lijiazhuang; the emperor ordered Sa Zai to survey and report.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Gao Jin memorialized that the Zhonghe River mouth was silt-blocked and proposed moving it downstream to Lijiazhuang. The emperor ordered Sa Zai to survey and report.

sentences.zh: 薩載請將清口東、西壩移築惠濟祠前，上從之。

translations.literal: Sa Zai asked to move the east and west dams at Qingkou to before the Huiji Temple; the emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Zai asked to move the east and west dams at Qingkou to before the Huiji Temple. The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，大學士阿桂奏：「陶莊引河首尾寬而中窄，河身雖已刷深，水勢尚嫌束縛。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year Grand Secretary Agui memorialized: "The Taozhuang diversion is wide at the ends and narrow in the middle; though the channel has been scoured deep, the current still seems constrained.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year Grand Secretary Agui memorialized: "The Taozhuang diversion is wide at the ends and narrow in the middle. Though the channel has been scoured deep, the current still seems constrained.

sentences.zh: 伏秋汛漲，恐宣洩不及。」

translations.literal: In dog-day and autumn floods, discharge may not keep up."
translations.idiomatic: In midsummer and autumn floods, discharge may not keep up."

sentences.zh: 命偕薩載勘覆。

translations.literal: He was ordered to survey with Sa Zai and report back.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to survey with Sa Zai and report back.

sentences.zh: 尋奏請河寬六十餘丈處展十餘丈，河寬不及六十丈處展二十餘丈。

translations.literal: Soon they memorialized to widen by over ten zhang where the river is over sixty zhang wide, and by over twenty zhang where it is less than sixty zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon they memorialized to widen by over ten zhang where the river is over sixty zhang wide, and by over twenty zhang where it is less than sixty zhang.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「雲梯關外二套以下河流現行之道，道遠而水淺，請於四泓以下增設閘壩；

translations.literal: They also memorialized: "Below Ertao outside Yuntiguan the river's present course is long and shallow; I ask to add sluices and dams below the Fourth Hong;
translations.idiomatic: They also memorialized: "Below Ertao outside Yuntiguan the river's present course is long and shallow. I ask to add sluices and dams below the Fourth Hong;

sentences.zh: 二套上迤西馬港河舊堤殘缺，應行修復；

translations.literal: above Ertao the old dike of Ximagang River is broken and should be repaired;
translations.idiomatic: above Ertao the old dike of Ximagang River is broken and should be repaired;

sentences.zh: 並於舊無堤處補築新堤，下接北潮河西堰。」

translations.literal: and where there was no dike, build a new dike connecting to the west dike of Beichao River."
translations.idiomatic: and where there was no dike, build a new dike connecting to the west dike of Beichao River."

sentences.zh: 上從之。

translations.literal: The emperor adopted this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor adopted this.

sentences.zh: 夏，河溢郭家渡，命薩載與河道總督陳輝祖督護。

translations.literal: In summer the river overflowed at Guojiadu; Sa Zai and River Works Governor-General Chen Huizu were ordered to supervise defense.
translations.idiomatic: In summer the river overflowed at Guojiadu. Sa Zai and river works governor-general Chen Huizu were ordered to supervise defense.

sentences.zh: 是歲河水盛漲，初開毛城鋪、蘇家山、峰山頭諸閘，次將清口東西壩全行拆展。

translations.literal: That year river water rose greatly; first the sluices at Maochengpu, Sujia Mountain, and Fengshantou were opened, then the east and west dams at Qingkou were fully opened.
translations.idiomatic: That year river water rose greatly. First the sluices at Maochengpu, Sujia Mountain, and Fengshantou were opened, then the east and west dams at Qingkou were fully opened.

sentences.zh: 薩載奏諸州縣被水，睢寧、泗州為重，邳州、宿遷、靈壁、五河次之，現在撫卹寧貼。

translations.literal: Sa Zai memorialized that prefectures and counties were flooded; Suining and Sizhou were worst, Pizhou, Suqian, Lingbi, and Wuhe next; relief and stabilization were now underway.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Zai memorialized that prefectures and counties were flooded. Suining and Sizhou were worst; Pizhou, Suqian, Lingbi, and Wuhe were next. Relief and stabilization were now underway.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「實在無善策，祗可盡力撫卹，以期補過。」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "There is truly no good plan; we can only do our utmost in relief to make amends."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "There is truly no good plan. We can only do our utmost in relief to make amends."

sentences.zh: 復命引河水入陶莊新河。

translations.literal: He was again ordered to divert river water into the new Taozhuang channel.
translations.idiomatic: He was again ordered to divert river water into the new Taozhuang channel.

sentences.zh: 尋奏豐、碭、銅、沛險工俱次第搶護，下游洪澤、高寶諸湖亦俱平定，俟水落堵築。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized that dangerous works in Feng, Dang, Tong, and Pei were all repaired in turn, and downstream Hongze and Gaobao lakes were all stabilized, awaiting low water for blocking and building.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he memorialized that dangerous works in Feng, Dang, Tong, and Pei were all repaired in turn, and downstream Hongze and Gaobao lakes were all stabilized, awaiting low water for blocking and building.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「覽奏深慰。」

translations.literal: He received an edict: "Reading your memorial deeply reassures."
translations.idiomatic: He received an edict: "Reading your memorial deeply reassures me."

sentences.zh: 先是，上臨高堰閱洪澤湖磚石諸工，諭薩載石工卑者增高，磚工悉改用石。

translations.literal: Earlier the emperor inspected Gaoyan and Hongze Lake brick and stone works and instructed Sa Zai to raise low stone works and replace all brick with stone.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the emperor inspected Gaoyan and Hongze Lake brick and stone works and instructed Sa Zai to raise low stone works and replace all brick with stone.

sentences.zh: 薩載奏請酌量緩急，分三年修築。

translations.literal: Sa Zai memorialized to gauge urgency and spread repairs over three years.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Zai memorialized to gauge urgency and spread repairs over three years.

sentences.zh: 八月，丁父憂，命百日滿後仍署兩江總督。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, upon his father's death, he was ordered after the hundred-day mourning period still to act as Governor-General of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, upon his father's death, he was ordered that after the hundred-day mourning period he would still serve as acting governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，奏請自李家莊至臨河集北濬引河，上命速為之。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year he memorialized to dredge a diversion from Lijiazhuang north to Linheji; the emperor ordered it done quickly.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year he memorialized to dredge a diversion from Lijiazhuang north to Linheji. The emperor ordered it done quickly.

sentences.zh: 六月，河溢魏家莊，水大至。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the river overflowed at Weijiazhuang and great floods came.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the river overflowed at Weijiazhuang and great floods came.

sentences.zh: 薩載奏：「全河奔注，歸入洪澤湖。

translations.literal: Sa Zai memorialized: "The whole river rushes in and enters Hongze Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Zai memorialized: "The whole river rushes in and enters Hongze Lake.

sentences.zh: 清口展寬至八十丈，山盱五壩已開智、義二壩；

translations.literal: Qingkou is opened to eighty zhang; of the five Shanxu dams, Zhi and Yi have been opened;
translations.idiomatic: Qingkou is opened to eighty zhang. Of the five Shanxu dams, Zhi and Yi have been opened;

sentences.zh: 而高堰諸地水勢未消，盈堤推岸。

translations.literal: but at Gaoyan and other places the water has not subsided, overflowing dikes and pushing banks.
translations.idiomatic: but at Gaoyan and other places the water has not subsided, overflowing dikes and pushing banks.

sentences.zh: 未開三壩及車邏、昭關二壩，或堅守，或酌開，俟察勘後續奏。」

translations.literal: The three unopened dams and Cheluo and Zhaoguan dams—whether to hold firm or open as needed—await survey and further report."
translations.idiomatic: The three unopened dams and the Cheluo and Zhaoguan dams—whether to hold firm or open as needed—await survey and further report."

sentences.zh: 上命堅守。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered them held firm.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered them held firm.

sentences.zh: 尋續奏洪澤湖浪湧山盱五壩，所存仁、禮二壩，掣通過水，續開車邏、昭關二壩。

translations.literal: Soon he further memorialized that Hongze Lake waves surged at the five Shanxu dams; the remaining Ren and Li dams were breached to pass water, and Cheluo and Zhaoguan dams were also opened.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he further memorialized that Hongze Lake waves surged at the five Shanxu dams. The remaining Ren and Li dams were breached to pass water, and the Cheluo and Zhaoguan dams were also opened.

sentences.zh: 上以各閘壩俱開，下河民田被淹，令察災狀速奏。

translations.literal: Because all sluices and dams were opened and lower-river fields were inundated, the emperor ordered disaster conditions surveyed and quickly reported.
translations.idiomatic: Because all sluices and dams were opened and lower-river fields were inundated, the emperor ordered disaster conditions surveyed and quickly reported.

sentences.zh: 八月魏家莊工竟。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Weijiazhuang work was finished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Weijiazhuang work was finished.

sentences.zh: 山東巡撫國泰奏運河積淤，水不能暢行，議於劉老澗壩旁開水口分洩，上命薩載往勘。

translations.literal: Shandong Governor Guotai memorialized that the canal was silted and water could not flow freely, proposing to open a mouth beside Liulaojian Dam to divert; the emperor ordered Sa Zai to survey.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong governor Guotai memorialized that the canal was silted and water could not flow freely, proposing to open a mouth beside Liulaojian Dam to divert. The emperor ordered Sa Zai to survey.

sentences.zh: 薩載奏：「運河洩水宣暢，已開駝車頭竹簍壩洩水入駱馬湖，劉老澗九孔石閘亦過水。

translations.literal: Sa Zai memorialized: "Canal discharge is free; the bamboo-weir dam at Tuochetou has been opened to release water into Luoma Lake, and the nine-opening stone sluice at Liulaojian also passes water.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Zai memorialized: "Canal discharge is free. The bamboo-weir dam at Tuochetou has been opened to release water into Luoma Lake, and the nine-opening stone sluice at Liulaojian also passes water.

sentences.zh: 若議別開水口，不便使無水之區再受水患。」

translations.literal: If another mouth is opened, it is not right to bring flood again to areas without water."
translations.idiomatic: If another mouth is opened, it is not right to bring flood again to areas that lack water."

sentences.zh: 上韙其言。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his words.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「微山湖東南兩面水色澄清，沂河及駱馬湖水不使涓滴入運，為運河騰空去路。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "On the southeast of Weishan Lake the water is clear; Yi River and Luoma Lake water are not allowed a drop into the canal, to clear the canal's path.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "On the southeast of Weishan Lake the water is clear. Yi River and Luoma Lake water are not allowed a drop into the canal, to clear the canal's path.

sentences.zh: 永濟橋孔亦無橫壩攔截，水勢暢消。」

translations.literal: Yongji Bridge openings also have no cross-dam blocking, and the water flows freely away."
translations.idiomatic: Yongji Bridge openings also have no cross-dam blocking, and the water flows freely away."

sentences.zh: 上稱為有條理，命國泰聽其指授，毋持己見。

translations.literal: The emperor called this well reasoned and ordered Guotai to follow his direction and not hold to his own view.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor called this well reasoned and ordered Guotai to follow his direction and not hold to his own view.

sentences.zh: 十二月，兼署安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he concurrently acted as Governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he concurrently served as acting governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，奏請濬泗州謝家溝，洩睢河及楊甿諸河水入洪澤湖；

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year he memorialized to dredge Xiejia Gou at Sizhou to discharge Sui River and Yangmeng waters into Hongze Lake;
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year he memorialized to dredge Xiejia Gou at Sizhou to discharge Sui River and Yangmeng waters into Hongze Lake;

sentences.zh: 又承上命濬銅山潘家屯引河。

translations.literal: he also carried out the imperial order to dredge the Panjiatun diversion at Tongshan.
translations.idiomatic: he also carried out the imperial order to dredge the Panjiatun diversion at Tongshan.

sentences.zh: 四月，河南青龍岡漫口既堵复蟄，大溜下注。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the breach at Qinglonggang in Henan, though blocked, sank again and the main current poured down.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the breach at Qinglonggang in Henan, though blocked, sank again and the main current poured down.

sentences.zh: 上命寬濬潘家屯、劉老澗諸河，洩水歸海。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered widening and dredging of Panjiatun, Liulaojian, and other rivers to discharge water to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered widening and dredging of Panjiatun, Liulaojian, and other rivers to discharge water to the sea.

sentences.zh: 薩載請開張家莊引河與潘家屯引河分流，使湖洩入黃又多一路。

translations.literal: Sa Zai asked to open the Zhangjiazhuang diversion to divide flow with Panjiatun, giving the lake another route into the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Zai asked to open the Zhangjiazhuang diversion to divide flow with Panjiatun, giving the lake another route into the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「籌洩水之路，為今日急務，宜妥為之。」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Planning discharge routes is today's urgent task; handle it properly."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "Planning discharge routes is today's urgent task. Handle it properly."

sentences.zh: 加太子少保。

translations.literal: He was made Junior Vice Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Junior Vice Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 江蘇巡撫吳壇議開金壇漕河，自丹徒穿句容境分水脊達江寧。

translations.literal: Jiangsu Governor Wu Tan proposed opening the Jintan transport canal from Dantu through Jurong along the watershed divide to reach Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu governor Wu Tan proposed opening the Jintan transport canal from Dantu through Jurong along the watershed divide to reach Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 薩載奏：「分水脊即茅山之麓，地峻土堅，勢不能開鑿。

translations.literal: Sa Zai memorialized: "The watershed divide is the foot of Mount Mao; the ground is steep and soil hard—it cannot be cut.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Zai memorialized: "The watershed divide is the foot of Mount Mao. The ground is steep and the soil hard—it cannot be cut.

sentences.zh: 請濬七里橋至巷口橋河道，與上、下河道寬深一律。」

translations.literal: I ask to dredge the channel from Qili Bridge to Xiangkou Bridge to match the upper and lower channels in width and depth."
translations.idiomatic: I ask to dredge the channel from Qili Bridge to Xiangkou Bridge to match the upper and lower channels in width and depth."

sentences.zh: 又請自鎮江錢家港至江寧龍潭濬闢新河，及修濬金山對渡瓜洲城河，上嘉之。

translations.literal: He also asked to dredge and open a new river from Qianjiagang at Zhenjiang to Longtan at Jiangning, and to repair the Guazhou city canal opposite Jinshan; the emperor praised this.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to dredge and open a new river from Qianjiagang at Zhenjiang to Longtan at Jiangning, and to repair the Guazhou city canal opposite Jinshan. The emperor praised this.

sentences.zh: 又奏請濬漣河，展駱馬湖六塘河、鹽河口門，均如議行。

translations.literal: He also memorialized to dredge the Lian River and widen the Liutang River and salt-river mouth at Luoma Lake; all were approved as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized to dredge the Lian River and widen the Liutang River and salt-river mouth at Luoma Lake. All were approved as proposed.

sentences.zh: 四十八年正月，服闋，實授兩江總督。

translations.literal: In the first month of the forty-eighth year, when mourning ended, he received substantive appointment as Governor-General of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the forty-eighth year, when mourning ended, he received substantive appointment as governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 河南青龍岡工竟，薩載奏黃河歸故道，入江南境流行迅速，得旨：「欣慰覽之！」

translations.literal: When the Qinglonggang work in Henan was finished, Sa Zai memorialized that the Yellow River returned to its old course and flowed swiftly entering Jiangnan; he received an edict: "Read with deep satisfaction!"
translations.idiomatic: When the Qinglonggang work in Henan was finished, Sa Zai memorialized that the Yellow River returned to its old course and flowed swiftly upon entering Jiangnan. He received an edict: "Read with deep satisfaction!"

sentences.zh: 上命移建沛縣城。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Peixian city moved and rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Peixian city moved and rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 薩載奏請移舊城西南戚山，並修夏鎮文武官署，豐、沛二縣漕倉。

translations.literal: Sa Zai memorialized to move the old city southwest to Qishan and repair civil and military offices at Xiazhen and transport granaries in Feng and Pei counties.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Zai memorialized to move the old city southwest to Qishan and repair civil and military offices at Xiazhen and transport granaries in Feng and Pei counties.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，江西巡撫郝碩坐婪賄得罪，責薩載未奏劾，下吏議，奪官，命留任，罰養廉三年。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year Jiangxi Governor Hao Shuo was punished for greedy bribery; Sa Zai was blamed for not memorializing impeachment, referred to officials for deliberation, stripped of office, ordered to remain at his post, and fined three years' integrity stipend.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year Jiangxi governor Hao Shuo was punished for greedy bribery. Sa Zai was blamed for not memorializing impeachment, referred to officials for deliberation, stripped of his rank, ordered to remain at his post, and fined three years' integrity stipend.

sentences.zh: 五十年，漕艘北行，以運中河淺阻，至天津誤期。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year transport boats going north were delayed reaching Tianjin because the middle canal was shallow and obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year transport boats going north were delayed reaching Tianjin because the middle canal was shallow and obstructed.

sentences.zh: 上責薩載開運中河不知建閘，水勢一泄無餘；

translations.literal: The emperor blamed Sa Zai for opening the middle canal without building sluices, so the water drained completely;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor blamed Sa Zai for opening the middle canal without building sluices, so the water drained completely;

sentences.zh: 又清口東、西壩不能及早收束預為蓄水，致運道淺阻。

translations.literal: and for not closing the east and west dams at Qingkou early to store water in advance, causing the transport route to be shallow and obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: and for not closing the east and west dams at Qingkou early to store water in advance, causing the transport route to be shallow and obstructed.

sentences.zh: 降三品頂帶。

translations.literal: He was demoted to third-rank insignia.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted to third-rank insignia.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，足疾，請解任。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year, with foot ailment, he asked to resign.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-first year, afflicted with a foot ailment, he asked to resign.

sentences.zh: 遣醫往視，命復原品。

translations.literal: A physician was sent to attend him and he was ordered restored to his original rank.
translations.idiomatic: A physician was sent to attend him and he was ordered restored to his original rank.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，贈太子太保，賜祭葬，諡誠恪，祀賢良祠。

translations.literal: Soon he died, posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted funeral rites, given the posthumous name Chengke, and enshrined in the Shrine of Worthy Officials.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he died. He was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted funeral rites, given the posthumous name Chengke, and enshrined in the Shrine of Worthy Officials.

sentences.zh: 子薩騰安，襲騎都尉，官至廣西按察使；

translations.literal: His son Sateng'an inherited the Commandant of Cavalry office and rose to judicial commissioner of Guangxi;
translations.idiomatic: His son Sateng'an inherited the Commandant of Cavalry office and rose to judicial commissioner of Guangxi;

sentences.zh: 薩雲安，官雲南迤西道，坐事戍軍台。

translations.literal: Sayun'an served in the Yixi circuit in Yunnan and was exiled to the military post for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: Sayun'an served in the Yixi circuit in Yunnan and was exiled to the military post for an offense.

sentences.zh: =蘭第錫=蘭第錫，山西吉州人。

translations.literal: Lan Dixi, a native of Jizhou in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Dixi came from Jizhou in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 舉人，授鳳臺教諭。

translations.literal: A provincial graduate, he was appointed instructor at Fengtai.
translations.idiomatic: A provincial graduate, he was appointed instructor at Fengtai.

sentences.zh: 擢順天大興知縣。

translations.literal: He was promoted to magistrate of Daxing in Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to magistrate of Daxing in Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，總督楊廷璋請以第錫升補永定河北岸同知，吏部以大興非沿河州縣，議駁，再請，上特許之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year Governor-General Yang Tingzhang asked to promote Dixi to vice-prefect of the north bank of the Yongding River; the Ministry of Personnel rejected it because Daxing is not a riverine prefecture or county; on second request the emperor specially permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year governor-general Yang Tingzhang asked to promote Dixi to vice-prefect of the north bank of the Yongding River. The Ministry of Personnel rejected it because Daxing is not a riverine prefecture or county. On a second request the emperor specially permitted it.

sentences.zh: 再遷永定河道。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to intendant of the Yongding River.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to intendant of the Yongding River.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，署河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year he acted as Governor-General of the Eastern River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year he served as acting governor-general of the Eastern River Works.

sentences.zh: 奏請河堤分界栽柳，並禁近堤取土；

translations.literal: He memorialized to plant willows along dike boundaries and forbid taking earth near dikes;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to plant willows along dike boundaries and forbid taking earth near dikes;

sentences.zh: 又奏儀封六堡、三堡灘面淺狹，水力較悍，請於新堤南築月隄為障；

translations.literal: he also memorialized that at Yifeng the Sixth and Third Fort bank faces are shallow and narrow and the current is fierce; he asked to build a moon dike south of the new dike as a barrier;
translations.idiomatic: he also memorialized that at Yifeng the Sixth and Third Fort bank faces are shallow and narrow and the current is fierce. He asked to build a moon dike south of the new dike as a barrier;

sentences.zh: 皆從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，奏：「河工綢繆防護，全在平時。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year he memorialized: "Careful protection of river works depends entirely on ordinary times.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year he memorialized: "Careful protection of river works depends entirely on ordinary times.

sentences.zh: 堤有深淺，水有變遷，及車馬踐踏，豸雚鼠洞穴，必朝夕在堤，始能目睹親切。

translations.literal: Dikes have deep and shallow places, water shifts, horses and carts trample, and badgers and rats burrow—one must be on the dike morning and evening to see clearly.
translations.idiomatic: Dikes have deep and shallow places, water shifts, horses and carts trample them, and badgers and rats burrow into them. One must be on the dike morning and evening to see conditions clearly.

sentences.zh: 至冬末凌汛，春初桃汛，尤應晝夜巡邏。

translations.literal: At the end of winter during ice floods and early spring during peach floods, patrol day and night is especially needed.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of winter during ice floods and early spring during peach floods, patrol day and night is especially needed.

sentences.zh: 應令駐工各員移至堤頂，禁勿私下；

translations.literal: Officials stationed at the works should be moved to the dike top and forbidden to leave privately;
translations.idiomatic: Officials stationed at the works should be moved to the dike top and forbidden to leave privately;

sentences.zh: 如有曠誤，文武得互舉。

translations.literal: if there is neglect, civil and military officials may impeach one another.
translations.idiomatic: if there is neglect, civil and military officials may impeach one another.

sentences.zh: 令以堤為家，庶不至疏防。」

translations.literal: Make the dike their home so defense is not neglected."
translations.idiomatic: Make the dike their home so that defense is not neglected."

sentences.zh: 均如所請行。

translations.literal: All was approved as requested.
translations.idiomatic: All was approved as requested.

sentences.zh: 五十年，奏：「北岸黃沁等廳、南岸上南等廳舊堤，及蘭儀等廳新堤，各增卑培薄；

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year he memorialized: "On the north bank at Huang-Qin and other offices, on the south bank at Shangnan and other offices, old dikes, and at Lan-Yi and other offices new dikes—each should have low sections raised and thin sections strengthened;
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year he memorialized: "On the north bank at Huang-Qin and other offices, on the south bank at Shangnan and other offices, old dikes, and at Lan-Yi and other offices new dikes—each should have low sections raised and thin sections strengthened;

sentences.zh: 並加築舊壩，添作挑水。」

translations.literal: and old dams should be reinforced and spillways added."
translations.idiomatic: and old dams should be reinforced and spillways added."

sentences.zh: 上命速行。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered swift implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered swift implementation.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，上以第錫署任三年，勤奮妥協，命實授。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year, because Dixi had acted three years with diligence and balanced handling, the emperor ordered substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-second year, because Dixi had served three years in an acting capacity with diligence and balanced handling, the emperor ordered a substantive appointment.

sentences.zh: 旋兼兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon he concurrently served as Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he concurrently served as vice minister of war.

sentences.zh: 河溢睢州十三堡，疏請罪，上以其地原無埽工，原之。

translations.literal: The river overflowed at the Thirteen Forts in Suizhou; he memorialized asking punishment; the emperor pardoned him because that place originally had no mat works.
translations.idiomatic: The river overflowed at the Thirteen Forts in Suizhou. He memorialized asking to be punished, but the emperor pardoned him because that place originally had no mat works.

sentences.zh: 工竟，議敘。

translations.literal: When the work was finished he was considered for reward.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was finished he was considered for reward.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，調江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year he was transferred to Governor-General of the Jiangnan River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year he was transferred to governor-general of the Jiangnan River Works.

sentences.zh: 河溢睢寧周家樓，疏請罪，上以河水異漲，原之。

translations.literal: The river overflowed at Zhoujialou in Suining; he memorialized asking punishment; the emperor pardoned him because the river rose abnormally.
translations.idiomatic: The river overflowed at Zhoujialou in Suining. He memorialized asking to be punished, but the emperor pardoned him because the river had risen abnormally.

sentences.zh: 工竟，議敘。

translations.literal: When the work was finished he was considered for reward.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was finished he was considered for reward.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，奏勘毛城鋪滾水壩、王平莊新挑引河，上獎第錫察驗各工不草率。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year he memorialized on surveying the spillway dam at Maochengpu and the newly dredged diversion at Wangpingzhuang; the emperor praised Dixi for inspecting works without carelessness.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year he memorialized on surveying the spillway dam at Maochengpu and the newly dredged diversion at Wangpingzhuang. The emperor praised Dixi for inspecting the works without carelessness.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，請自淮安移駐清江浦，改建衙署，允之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year he asked to move his station from Huai'an to Qingjiangpu and rebuild the yamen; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year he asked to move his station from Huai'an to Qingjiangpu and rebuild the yamen. This was approved.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，奏豐北汛接築土壩過多，上游水勢不能暢達，有礙曹、單河流去路，自請下吏議奪官，上命留任。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year he memorialized that too many earthen dams were built in succession at Fengbei flood section, blocking upstream flow and hindering the course of Cao and Shan rivers; he asked officials to deliberate stripping his office; the emperor ordered him to remain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year he memorialized that too many earthen dams were built in succession at the Fengbei flood section, blocking upstream flow and hindering the course of the Cao and Shan rivers. He asked officials to deliberate stripping his office, but the emperor ordered him to remain at his post.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，河溢豐北汛，疏請罪，諭俟工竣覈功過。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing the river overflowed at Fengbei flood section; he memorialized asking punishment; he was instructed to await completion of the work before judging merit and fault.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiaqing the river overflowed at the Fengbei flood section. He memorialized asking to be punished and was instructed to await completion of the work before judging merit and fault.

sentences.zh: 工竟，賜黃辮荷包，仍以不能先事預防停甄敘。

translations.literal: When the work was finished he was granted a yellow-braid purse, but because he had not prevented the matter in advance, consideration for reward was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was finished he was granted a yellow-braid purse, but because he had not prevented the matter in advance, consideration for reward was suspended.

sentences.zh: 二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the second year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he died.

sentences.zh: 三年，第錫以河溢當償帑二十萬餘兩。

translations.literal: In the third year Dixi owed over 200,000 taels to the treasury for river overflow.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Dixi owed over 200,000 taels to the treasury for river overflow.

sentences.zh: 上以第錫尚廉潔，慮不能勝，諮山西巡撫伯麟，伯麟奏第錫遺田舍僅值一百四十餘兩。

translations.literal: Because Dixi was still known for integrity, the emperor feared he could not bear it and consulted Shanxi Governor Bolin; Bolin memorialized that Dixi's remaining fields and houses were worth only a little over 140 taels.
translations.idiomatic: Because Dixi was still known for integrity, the emperor feared he could not bear the burden and consulted Shanxi governor Bolin. Bolin memorialized that Dixi's remaining fields and houses were worth only a little over 140 taels.

sentences.zh: 上獎第錫清慎，諭道、廳以上及曾任總河各員分別代償。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Dixi for purity and caution and instructed circuit officials and above and former river governors-general to repay on his behalf respectively.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Dixi for purity and caution and instructed circuit officials and above and former river governors-general to repay on his behalf respectively.

sentences.zh: =韓鑅=韓鑅，順天大興人，原籍貴州畢節。

translations.literal: Han Heng, a native of Daxing in Shuntian, originally registered in Bijie in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Han Heng came from Daxing in Shuntian and was originally registered in Bijie in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 入貲授通判，揀發山東，授上河通判。

translations.literal: He purchased office as vice-prefect, was selected for Shandong, and appointed vice-prefect of the upper river.
translations.idiomatic: He purchased office as a vice-prefect, was selected for Shandong, and appointed vice-prefect of the upper river.

sentences.zh: 累擢江南淮徐道。

translations.literal: He was promoted to the Huai-Xu circuit in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to the Huai-Xu circuit in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十六年，授河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year of Qianlong he was appointed Governor-General of the Eastern River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year of Qianlong he was appointed governor-general of the Eastern River Works.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「山東運河，賴汶、泗來源及各湖接濟。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The Shandong canal relies on the Wen and Si sources and supply from the various lakes.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The Shandong canal relies on the Wen and Si sources and supply from the various lakes.

sentences.zh: 汶河上游東平戴村等處民堰，對岸沙淤，應鑿灘抽溝，以展河勢。

translations.literal: Civilian dikes upstream on the Wen at Dongping, Daicun, and elsewhere face silt on the opposite bank; the bank should be cut and channels dredged to widen the river.
translations.idiomatic: Civilian dikes upstream on the Wen at Dongping, Daicun, and elsewhere face silt on the opposite bank. The bank should be cut and channels dredged to widen the river.

sentences.zh: 泗河下游即為府河，自安居、十里二斗門入運，河淺堰卑，亦當疏治。

translations.literal: The lower Si is the prefectural canal, entering transport through the Anju and Shili sluices; the river is shallow and dams low and should also be dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The lower Si is the prefectural canal, entering the transport system through the Anju and Shili sluices. The river is shallow and the dams low and should also be dredged.

sentences.zh: 蜀山、馬踏、馬場、南旺諸湖，現當濟運洩水，堰根顯露，正可取土培堤。」

translations.literal: Shushan, Mata, Machang, Nanwang, and other lakes are now supplying transport and releasing water; dam roots are exposed and earth may be taken to strengthen dikes."
translations.idiomatic: Shushan, Mata, Machang, Nanwang, and other lakes are now supplying transport and releasing water. Dam roots are exposed and earth may be taken to strengthen the dikes."

sentences.zh: 七月，河決祥符焦橋，疏請罪，上原之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the river broke at Jiaoqiao in Xiangfu; he memorialized asking punishment; the emperor pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the river broke at Jiaoqiao in Xiangfu. He memorialized asking to be punished, and the emperor pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 工竟，命優敘。

translations.literal: When the work was finished he was ordered given preferential consideration for reward.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was finished he was ordered given preferential consideration for reward.

sentences.zh: 未幾，河又決儀封曲家樓、青龍岡、大李家莊、孔家莊，凡溢四口。

translations.literal: Before long the river broke again at Qujialou in Yifeng, Qinglonggang, Da Lijiazhuang, and Kongjiazhuang—four breaches in all.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the river broke again at Qujialou in Yifeng, Qinglonggang, Da Lijiazhuang, and Kongjiazhuang—four breaches in all.

sentences.zh: 上令江南河道總督李奉翰赴工會督。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Jiangnan River Works Governor-General Li Fenghan to the works to supervise jointly.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Jiangnan river works governor-general Li Fenghan to the works to supervise jointly.

sentences.zh: 水全出青龍岡，而孔家莊等三口皆塞。

translations.literal: All water exited at Qinglonggang, while Kongjiazhuang and the other three mouths were blocked.
translations.idiomatic: All the water exited at Qinglonggang, while Kongjiazhuang and the other three mouths were blocked.

sentences.zh: 又命大學士阿桂履勘，又令山東巡撫國泰赴工會督。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Agui was again ordered to survey on site, and Shandong Governor Guotai was ordered to the works to supervise jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Agui was again ordered to survey on site, and Shandong governor Guotai was ordered to the works to supervise jointly.

sentences.zh: 工垂竟，壩蟄复潰。

translations.literal: When the work was nearly finished the dam sank and breached again.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was nearly finished the dam sank and breached again.

sentences.zh: 大學士嵇璜議引河北流復故道，上以諮阿桂、李奉翰及鑅。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Ji Huang proposed diverting the river north to restore the old course; the emperor consulted Agui, Li Fenghan, and Heng.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Ji Huang proposed diverting the river north to restore the old course. The emperor consulted Agui, Li Fenghan, and Heng.

sentences.zh: 鑅疏言：「青龍岡始漫，勢甚洶湧，是以倒漾北行，分入沙、趙二河，穿運歸海。

translations.literal: Heng memorialized: "When Qinglonggang first overflowed the force was very violent, so water surged north, divided into the Sha and Zhao rivers, crossed the canal, and reached the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Heng memorialized: "When Qinglonggang first overflowed the force was very violent, so water surged north, divided into the Sha and Zhao rivers, crossed the canal, and reached the sea.

sentences.zh: 未久旋即斷流，仍行南注。

translations.literal: Before long it cut off and again flowed south.
translations.idiomatic: Before long it cut off and again flowed south.

sentences.zh: 地勢北高南下，若於南岸建堤堵截，欲回狂瀾使之北注，誠如聖諭必不能行。

translations.literal: The terrain is high in the north and low in the south; if a dike is built on the south bank to block and turn the raging current north, as the sacred instruction says, it truly cannot be done.
translations.idiomatic: The terrain is high in the north and low in the south. If a dike is built on the south bank to block and turn the raging current north, as the sacred instruction says, it truly cannot be done.

sentences.zh: 水性就下，未便輕議更張。」

translations.literal: Water by nature seeks the lower level; it is not right lightly to propose changing course."
translations.idiomatic: Water by nature seeks the lower level. It is not right lightly to propose changing course."

sentences.zh: 阿桂等所奏亦略同，乃寢璜議，惟以河水北行既已斷流，責鑅何不即時具奏。

translations.literal: Agui and others memorialized similarly; Huang's proposal was shelved, but because the northward flow had already cut off, Heng was blamed for not reporting promptly.
translations.idiomatic: Agui and others memorialized similarly. Huang's proposal was shelved, but because the northward flow had already cut off, Heng was blamed for not reporting promptly.

sentences.zh: 四十七年正月，壩复蟄。

translations.literal: In the first month of the forty-seventh year the dam sank again.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the forty-seventh year the dam sank again.

sentences.zh: 上聞運道河以南深通，河以北多淤墊，命鑅往微山湖北運河察勘。

translations.literal: The emperor heard that south of the transport route the river was deep and clear but north was much silted; he ordered Heng to survey the transport canal north of Weishan Lake.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor heard that south of the transport route the river was deep and clear but north was much silted. He ordered Heng to survey the transport canal north of Weishan Lake.

sentences.zh: 二月，赴濟寧，會國泰及巡漕御史毓奇察勘，請自濟寧在城閘至嶧縣黃林莊，築土堰、柴壩、椿埽、橋樑，設水站，置絞關；

translations.literal: In the second month he went to Jining, joined Guotai and Transport Censor Yu Qi in survey, and asked from the in-city sluice at Jining to Huanglinzhuang in Yixian to build earthen dams, brush dams, pile-and-mat works, bridges, water stations, and capstans;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he went to Jining, joined Guotai and transport censor Yu Qi in survey, and asked from the in-city sluice at Jining to Huanglinzhuang in Yixian to build earthen dams, brush dams, pile-and-mat works, bridges, water stations, and capstans;

sentences.zh: 鑅並請察勘畢，還青龍岡工次。

translations.literal: Heng also asked that after survey he return to the Qinglonggang works.
translations.idiomatic: Heng also asked that after the survey he return to the Qinglonggang works.

sentences.zh: 上命鑅往來督察，复勘伊家河、荊山橋諸地水勢，請濬銅山潘家屯引河益使寬深，並濬駱馬湖、六塘河及濟寧南北徒駭、馬頰、伊家等河。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Heng to supervise back and forth, again survey water conditions at Yijia River, Jingshan Bridge, and elsewhere, ask to dredge the Panjiatun diversion at Tongshan wider and deeper, and dredge Luoma Lake, Liutang River, and north and south of Jining the Tuhai, Majia, Yijia, and other rivers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Heng to supervise back and forth, again survey water conditions at Yijia River, Jingshan Bridge, and elsewhere, ask to dredge the Panjiatun diversion at Tongshan wider and deeper, and dredge Luoma Lake, Liutang River, and north and south of Jining the Tuhai, Majia, Yijia, and other rivers.

sentences.zh: 時青龍岡壩屢築屢蟄，鑅遵上指迅籌宣洩，使黃水漸消。

translations.literal: At that time the Qinglonggang dam was built and sank repeatedly; Heng followed the imperial direction, quickly planned discharge, and gradually reduced the Yellow water.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Qinglonggang dam was built and sank repeatedly. Heng followed the imperial direction, quickly planned discharge, and gradually reduced the Yellow water.

sentences.zh: 復還青龍岡工次，會阿桂等於蘭陽三堡改築大堤，濬渠導水出商丘七堡入正河故道。

translations.literal: He returned again to Qinglonggang works, joined Agui and others in rebuilding the great dike at the three forts in Lanyang, dredged a channel to guide water from the seven forts at Shangqiu into the main river's old course.
translations.idiomatic: He returned again to the Qinglonggang works, joined Agui and others in rebuilding the great dike at the three forts in Lanyang, and dredged a channel to guide water from the seven forts at Shangqiu into the main river's old course.

sentences.zh: 鑅旋以父憂去。

translations.literal: Heng soon left on his father's death.
translations.idiomatic: Heng soon left office upon his father's death.

sentences.zh: 四十八年三月，青龍岡工始竟。

translations.literal: In the third month of the forty-eighth year the Qinglonggang work was at last finished.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the forty-eighth year the Qinglonggang work was at last finished.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，服闋，授工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year, when mourning ended, he was appointed Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year, when mourning ended, he was appointed vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 部議鑅任河督時應償帑十四萬餘兩，詔免十之七。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated that Heng owed over 140,000 taels from his term as river governor; an edict remitted seven-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated that Heng owed over 140,000 taels from his term as river governor. An edict remitted seven-tenths.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，命會勘通惠、溫榆二河，及朝陽門外護城河。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year he was ordered to survey jointly the Tonghui and Wenyu rivers and the moat outside Chaoyang Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year he was ordered to survey jointly the Tonghui and Wenyu rivers and the moat outside Chaoyang Gate.

sentences.zh: 調戶部。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，命往江南會同江南河道總督蘭第錫督防汛。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year he was ordered to Jiangnan to join Jiangnan River Works Governor-General Lan Dixi in supervising flood defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year he was ordered to Jiangnan to join Jiangnan river works governor-general Lan Dixi in supervising flood defense.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，調兵部。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing he was transferred to the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiaqing he was transferred to the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，命守護裕陵。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year he was ordered to guard Yuling.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year he was ordered to guard Yuling.

sentences.zh: 六年，以年老休致。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, on account of age, he retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on account of age, he retired.

sentences.zh: 九年，卒。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he died.

sentences.zh: =【論】=論曰：世業尚矣，於河事尤可徵。

translations.literal: Commentary says: Hereditary professions have long been honored, and this is especially evident in river affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Hereditary professions have long been honored, and this is especially evident in river affairs.

sentences.zh: 前乎此者，嵇曾筠有子璜，高斌有從子高晉。

translations.literal: Before this, Ji Zengyun had the son Huang, and Gao Bin had the collateral descendant Gao Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, Ji Zengyun had the son Huang, and Gao Bin had the collateral descendant Gao Jin.

sentences.zh: 若李氏、何氏、吳氏皆繼之而起，宏及子奉翰、煟及子裕城並有名乾隆朝，嗣爵子璥則下逮嘉慶，奉翰子亨特，貪侈隕績，忝祖父矣。

translations.literal: The Li, He, and Wu families all rose in succession; Hong and his son Fenghan, Wei and his son Yucheng were all famous in the Qianlong reign; Sijue's son Jin extended into Jiaqing; Fenghan's son Hengte, greedy and extravagant, ruined his record and disgraced his forebears.
translations.idiomatic: The Li, He, and Wu families all rose in succession. Hong and his son Fenghan, Wei and his son Yucheng were all famous in the Qianlong reign. Sijue's son Jin extended into the Jiaqing reign. Fenghan's son Hengte, greedy and extravagant, ruined his record and disgraced his forebears.

sentences.zh: 清時以誠篤名，第錫以廉潔著。

translations.literal: Qingshi was known for sincerity, Dixi for integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Qingshi was known for sincerity, Dixi for integrity.

sentences.zh: 青龍岡塞河決，歷兩載工始竟，阿桂主之，薩載、韓鑅佐之。

translations.literal: The Qinglonggang breach was closed after two years' work; Agui led it, Sa Zai and Han Heng assisted.
translations.idiomatic: The Qinglonggang breach was closed after two years of work. Agui led it, and Sa Zai and Han Heng assisted.

sentences.zh: 詳具其始末，見成功之難也。

translations.literal: The full account of its beginning and end shows how hard success is.
translations.idiomatic: The full account of its beginning and end shows how hard success is.
